entries.name: Rent Decomposition (Tightness vs Monopoly Rent)
entries.essence: Split operating profit into monopoly rent (from a structural chokepoint; persists across constraint states) and tightness rent (from the constraint's current visit; leaves with it). The confession to watch: incumbents converting rent to contract (take-or-pay, price floors, multi-year) reveal which rent they actually have.
entries.apply: Before pricing or valuing any position — decompose the rent, then contract it or size for its departure.
entries.body:
Split operating profit into monopoly rent (from a structural chokepoint; persists across constraint states) and tightness rent (from the constraint's current visit; leaves with it). The confession to watch: incumbents converting rent to contract (take-or-pay, price floors, multi-year) reveal which rent they actually have.
- **Apply**: Before pricing or valuing any position — decompose the rent, then contract it or size for its departure.

entries.name: The Rotation Test
entries.essence: Three questions on a position: which constraint state current economics depend on; whether the position sits on the constraint's return path (own the station the constraint returns to; the visited station is a trade in strategy's clothes); and in which not-yet-happened state the design fails structurally.
entries.apply: Layer 2 — to distinguish a freehold from a lease from a trade, and to feed named failure states into Layers 4 and 7.
entries.body:
Three questions on a position: which constraint state current economics depend on; whether the position sits on the constraint's return path (own the station the constraint returns to; the visited station is a trade in strategy's clothes); and in which not-yet-happened state the design fails structurally.
- **Apply**: Layer 2 — to distinguish a freehold from a lease from a trade, and to feed named failure states into Layers 4 and 7.

entries.name: The Three-Exposure Dependency Inventory
entries.essence: For every rented input, score toll (the price can rise), gate (access can close), and learning (the flow condenses the firm's edge into the counterparty) — the last being the transfer that never sends an invoice. Then engineer joints: second sources, rehearsed exportability, ring-fenced learning, dependency on categories not counterparties.
entries.apply: Mode 5 — to price platform/vendor risk at design time rather than at renewal.
entries.body:
For every rented input, score toll (the price can rise), gate (access can close), and learning (the flow condenses the firm's edge into the counterparty) — the last being the transfer that never sends an invoice. Then engineer joints: second sources, rehearsed exportability, ring-fenced learning, dependency on categories not counterparties.
- **Apply**: Mode 5 — to price platform/vendor risk at design time rather than at renewal.

entries.name: The Meter Placement Model
entries.essence: Value flows through a pipe; the meter belongs at maximum irreducibility — commitment, clearing, consumption of the newly marginal cost, residence — and fails at summarizable content and matchable features. A well-placed meter is also the firm's best telemetry instrument.
entries.apply: Mode 6 — designing pricing and monetization architecture.
entries.body:
Value flows through a pipe; the meter belongs at maximum irreducibility — commitment, clearing, consumption of the newly marginal cost, residence — and fails at summarizable content and matchable features. A well-placed meter is also the firm's best telemetry instrument.
- **Apply**: Mode 6 — designing pricing and monetization architecture.

entries.name: The Load-Bearing Frame (VTDF)
entries.essence: The four irreversible choices — Value, Technology, Distribution, Finance — drawn as a structural frame, each member colored by coherence verdict with the binding incoherence flagged.
entries.apply: Modes 1–2 — to visualize and test whether the four choices cohere and where the design fails.
entries.body:
The four irreversible choices — Value, Technology, Distribution, Finance — drawn as a structural frame, each member colored by coherence verdict with the binding incoherence flagged.
- **Apply**: Modes 1–2 — to visualize and test whether the four choices cohere and where the design fails.

entries.name: The Rotation Mismatch
entries.essence: The environment reprices in quarters while the firm rebuilds in years; therefore design for the constraint structure, not the current constraint.
entries.apply: The governing lens for the whole discipline; foregrounded in Layer 0.
entries.body:
The environment reprices in quarters while the firm rebuilds in years; therefore design for the constraint structure, not the current constraint.
- **Apply**: The governing lens for the whole discipline; foregrounded in Layer 0.

entries.name: Templates Are Frozen Answers
entries.essence: Inherited pattern books (SaaS, marketplace, attention, platform, hardware, services pyramid) are frozen answers whose era-assumptions break on schedule at era boundaries.
entries.apply: Layer 0 template-exposure check; re-derive the four choices from first questions rather than running an expired playbook.
entries.body:
Inherited pattern books (SaaS, marketplace, attention, platform, hardware, services pyramid) are frozen answers whose era-assumptions break on schedule at era boundaries.
- **Apply**: Layer 0 template-exposure check; re-derive the four choices from first questions rather than running an expired playbook.

entries.name: Stories Expire With Constraints
entries.essence: Designs made at a constraint narrative's peak ("compute is destiny") are made for the state about to end.
entries.apply: Layer 0 — guard against narrative-peak design; design against the structure, not the story.
entries.body:
Designs made at a constraint narrative's peak ("compute is destiny") are made for the state about to end.
- **Apply**: Layer 0 — guard against narrative-peak design; design against the structure, not the story.

entries.name: Fund the Bet That Kills You
entries.essence: The discontinuous bet that would obsolete the design should be funded by this firm — or a competitor will fund it.
entries.apply: Layer 1 Technology second-barbell check; corrects the Unfunded Killer failure pattern.
entries.body:
The discontinuous bet that would obsolete the design should be funded by this firm — or a competitor will fund it.
- **Apply**: Layer 1 Technology second-barbell check; corrects the Unfunded Killer failure pattern.

entries.name: Distribution First
entries.essence: The channel constrains everything; choose it before the product.
entries.apply: Layer 1 Distribution — sequence the channel decision ahead of the product decision.
entries.body:
The channel constrains everything; choose it before the product.
- **Apply**: Layer 1 Distribution — sequence the channel decision ahead of the product decision.

entries.name: The Rented Front Door
entries.essence: A rented channel is reach purchased with dependency — a term sheet the landlord can reopen.
entries.apply: Layer 1 Distribution and Mode 5 — score the rented-door share of demand and price it.
entries.body:
A rented channel is reach purchased with dependency — a term sheet the landlord can reopen.
- **Apply**: Layer 1 Distribution and Mode 5 — score the rented-door share of demand and price it.

entries.name: The Second Readership
entries.essence: On a machine-majority web, agent legibility (structured data, APIs, protocols) is the new indexability.
entries.apply: Layer 1 Distribution — check the design is legible to machines, not only humans.
entries.body:
On a machine-majority web, agent legibility (structured data, APIs, protocols) is the new indexability.
- **Apply**: Layer 1 Distribution — check the design is legible to machines, not only humans.

entries.name: Capital Intensity Is a Choice
entries.essence: Capital intensity spans three orders of magnitude within one industry; match it deliberately to the durability of the position it buys.
entries.apply: Layer 1 Finance and Mode 8 — choose intensity against proven position durability; corrects the Premature Build.
entries.body:
Capital intensity spans three orders of magnitude within one industry; match it deliberately to the durability of the position it buys.
- **Apply**: Layer 1 Finance and Mode 8 — choose intensity against proven position durability; corrects the Premature Build.

entries.name: The Terminal Margin Is the Whole Position
entries.essence: For designs without long-duration assets, the mature gross margin (with AI costs at scale, and who controls the levers) is effectively the entire position; inference as a pass-through outsources margin to a vendor's pricing committee.
entries.apply: Layer 1 Finance — write the terminal-margin thesis and secure a firm-controlled cost lever.
entries.body:
For designs without long-duration assets, the mature gross margin (with AI costs at scale, and who controls the levers) is effectively the entire position; inference as a pass-through outsources margin to a vendor's pricing committee.
- **Apply**: Layer 1 Finance — write the terminal-margin thesis and secure a firm-controlled cost lever.

entries.name: A Position Is What the Filings Say
entries.essence: A position is what the margins, capital intensity, and dependency map say it is — never what the vision or pitch says.
entries.apply: Hard rule across Layer 2; when the engine contradicts self-description, the position card outranks the pitch.
entries.body:
A position is what the margins, capital intensity, and dependency map say it is — never what the vision or pitch says.
- **Apply**: Hard rule across Layer 2; when the engine contradicts self-description, the position card outranks the pitch.

entries.name: Own the Station the Constraint Returns To
entries.essence: Value comes from owning the station the constraint returns to; owning the currently-visited station is a trade dressed as strategy.
entries.apply: Layer 2 rotation test — evaluate whether a position is on the constraint's return path.
entries.body:
Value comes from owning the station the constraint returns to; owning the currently-visited station is a trade dressed as strategy.
- **Apply**: Layer 2 rotation test — evaluate whether a position is on the constraint's return path.

entries.name: The Failing State
entries.essence: A design with no state in which it fails structurally usually has no position; a design with several failing states is a trade.
entries.apply: Layer 2 and Mode 7 — use failing-state count as a position/trade diagnostic.
entries.body:
A design with no state in which it fails structurally usually has no position; a design with several failing states is a trade.
- **Apply**: Layer 2 and Mode 7 — use failing-state count as a position/trade diagnostic.

entries.name: The Daily-Mechanism Test
entries.essence: Every claimed moat must name the daily operation whose by-product is defensibility; a moat with no daily mechanism is a metaphor.
entries.apply: Layer 3 and Mode 4 — filter real moats from claimed ones.
entries.body:
Every claimed moat must name the daily operation whose by-product is defensibility; a moat with no daily mechanism is a metaphor.
- **Apply**: Layer 3 and Mode 4 — filter real moats from claimed ones.

entries.name: The Accumulated Fit
entries.essence: Competitors can rent your model but not your ten thousand corrections — the co-adapted loop of model, harness, context, and corrections, built inside the firm's own walls from day one.
entries.apply: Layer 3 compounding menu; a day-one moat requirement handed to Agent Engineering.
entries.body:
Competitors can rent your model but not your ten thousand corrections — the co-adapted loop of model, harness, context, and corrections, built inside the firm's own walls from day one.
- **Apply**: Layer 3 compounding menu; a day-one moat requirement handed to Agent Engineering.

entries.name: Residence
entries.essence: Own where machine work accumulates; export ease becomes the trust feature.
entries.apply: Layer 3 — moat via being the system of record; also a Mode 6 meter point.
entries.body:
Own where machine work accumulates; export ease becomes the trust feature.
- **Apply**: Layer 3 — moat via being the system of record; also a Mode 6 meter point.

entries.name: Clearing and Standing
entries.essence: The oldest durable moats (verification, transactions with identity/payment/liability); the machine web strengthens them.
entries.apply: Layer 3 — recognize and build toward clearing/standing positions.
entries.body:
The oldest durable moats (verification, transactions with identity/payment/liability); the machine web strengthens them.
- **Apply**: Layer 3 — recognize and build toward clearing/standing positions.

entries.name: The Standards Game
entries.essence: Give away the language, own the toll booth — the shipping container's game; won early or not at all.
entries.apply: Layer 3 and Mode 8 (own first what cannot be added later) — standards/protocol seats.
entries.body:
Give away the language, own the toll booth — the shipping container's game; won early or not at all.
- **Apply**: Layer 3 and Mode 8 (own first what cannot be added later) — standards/protocol seats.

entries.name: The Pace Car
entries.essence: Model quality now sets the tempo but protects no one who merely keeps up; it is a retired moat.
entries.apply: Layer 3 retired list — refuse to budget model quality (or feature velocity, raw data volume, headcount scale, summarizable attention) as defensibility.
entries.body:
Model quality now sets the tempo but protects no one who merely keeps up; it is a retired moat.
- **Apply**: Layer 3 retired list — refuse to budget model quality (or feature velocity, raw data volume, headcount scale, summarizable attention) as defensibility.

entries.name: Swap, Not Rebuild
entries.essence: Modularity at the joints means every rented component sits behind an interface the firm controls, so a repricing becomes a swap rather than a rebuild.
entries.apply: Layer 4 — audit the joints for controlled interfaces.
entries.body:
Modularity at the joints means every rented component sits behind an interface the firm controls, so a repricing becomes a swap rather than a rebuild.
- **Apply**: Layer 4 — audit the joints for controlled interfaces.

entries.name: Reversibility Is a Budget Line
entries.essence: Reversibility (expensed vs capitalized, short vs long commitments, convertible positions) is paid for visibly and sized to the rotation's speed.
entries.apply: Layer 4 and Mode 8 — budget reversibility explicitly; corrects the Premature Build.
entries.body:
Reversibility (expensed vs capitalized, short vs long commitments, convertible positions) is paid for visibly and sized to the rotation's speed.
- **Apply**: Layer 4 and Mode 8 — budget reversibility explicitly; corrects the Premature Build.

entries.name: Priced Dependency
entries.essence: A dependency priced at design time is an input; priced at renewal it is a hostage negotiation.
entries.apply: Mode 5 — run the three-exposure inventory now, not at contract renewal.
entries.body:
A dependency priced at design time is an input; priced at renewal it is a hostage negotiation.
- **Apply**: Mode 5 — run the three-exposure inventory now, not at contract renewal.

entries.name: Sequence Beats State
entries.essence: Own first what cannot be added later; rent first what teaches fastest; convert at the capture points when learning justifies it.
entries.apply: Mode 8 — the ordering law for build sequences.
entries.body:
Own first what cannot be added later; rent first what teaches fastest; convert at the capture points when learning justifies it.
- **Apply**: Mode 8 — the ordering law for build sequences.

entries.name: The Clean-Sheet Test
entries.essence: The standing design must beat today's redesign — or borrow from it.
entries.apply: Mode 2 / annual exercise — benchmark the existing firm against a clean-sheet founding.
entries.body:
The standing design must beat today's redesign — or borrow from it.
- **Apply**: Mode 2 / annual exercise — benchmark the existing firm against a clean-sheet founding.

entries.name: Strategy Is Structure
entries.essence: Good strategy is positioned where the rotation returns, metered where every state passes, and jointed where the constraint strikes.
entries.apply: Closing synthesis lens tying position, capture, and structure into one verdict.
entries.body:
Good strategy is positioned where the rotation returns, metered where every state passes, and jointed where the constraint strikes.
- **Apply**: Closing synthesis lens tying position, capture, and structure into one verdict.

entries.name: D0 Implicit
entries.essence: The four choices were never made on purpose; the position is inherited.
entries.apply: Baseline diagnosis for firms with no deliberate design.
entries.body:
The four choices were never made on purpose; the position is inherited.
- **Apply**: Baseline diagnosis for firms with no deliberate design.

entries.name: D1 Narrated
entries.essence: Strategy exists as story; no filings-grade evidence ties to it.
entries.apply: Most strategies audit here; flag the absence of evidence.
entries.body:
Strategy exists as story; no filings-grade evidence ties to it.
- **Apply**: Most strategies audit here; flag the absence of evidence.

entries.name: D2 Placed
entries.essence: Position identified from real economics; rent decomposition done; template exposure named.
entries.apply: Achieved once Layer 2 is run honestly.
entries.body:
Position identified from real economics; rent decomposition done; template exposure named.
- **Apply**: Achieved once Layer 2 is run honestly.

entries.name: D3 Chosen
entries.essence: The four choices coherent; terminal-margin thesis written; meter placed at irreducibility; dependencies priced.
entries.apply: The target of the payoff jump — D1→D3 is placement and choices, not vision work.
entries.body:
The four choices coherent; terminal-margin thesis written; meter placed at irreducibility; dependencies priced.
- **Apply**: The target of the payoff jump — D1→D3 is placement and choices, not vision work.

entries.name: D4 Structured
entries.essence: Joints modular, reversibility budgeted, options live against named failure states, falsifier register reviewed on cadence.
entries.apply: Reached when Layer 4 practices are in place.
entries.body:
Joints modular, reversibility budgeted, options live against named failure states, falsifier register reviewed on cadence.
- **Apply**: Reached when Layer 4 practices are in place.

entries.name: D5 Compounding
entries.essence: Moat mechanisms run daily with measurable accrual; the design has survived at least one rotation with corrections logged.
entries.apply: The compounding endstate; proven through a completed rotation.
entries.body:
Moat mechanisms run daily with measurable accrual; the design has survived at least one rotation with corrections logged.
- **Apply**: The compounding endstate; proven through a completed rotation.

entries.name: Aspiration-Position Mismatch
entries.essence: The deck says platform while the margins say assembler — position claimed from vision.
entries.apply: Fix via Layer 2 placement from the filings; rename the strategy or change the economics.
entries.body:
The deck says platform while the margins say assembler — position claimed from vision.
- **Apply**: Fix via Layer 2 placement from the filings; rename the strategy or change the economics.

entries.name: Template Inheritance
entries.essence: A SaaS/attention/marketplace playbook run after its era, mistaking a pattern book for law.
entries.apply: Fix by re-deriving the four choices from the questions.
entries.body:
A SaaS/attention/marketplace playbook run after its era, mistaking a pattern book for law.
- **Apply**: Fix by re-deriving the four choices from the questions.

entries.name: Terminal-Margin Blindness
entries.essence: Growth applauded while gross margin erodes with every AI feature.
entries.apply: Fix by writing the terminal-margin thesis and securing a firm-controlled cost lever.
entries.body:
Growth applauded while gross margin erodes with every AI feature.
- **Apply**: Fix by writing the terminal-margin thesis and securing a firm-controlled cost lever.

entries.name: The Rented Whole
entries.essence: The entire front door is one landlord's discretion.
entries.apply: Fix via dependency pricing; build or buy a second door before renewal.
entries.body:
The entire front door is one landlord's discretion.
- **Apply**: Fix via dependency pricing; build or buy a second door before renewal.

entries.name: Tightness Capitalized
entries.essence: The constraint's visit priced as a permanent chokepoint — in valuation, hiring, or capex.
entries.apply: Fix via rent decomposition; contract the rent or size for its departure.
entries.body:
The constraint's visit priced as a permanent chokepoint — in valuation, hiring, or capex.
- **Apply**: Fix via rent decomposition; contract the rent or size for its departure.

entries.name: Moat as Metaphor
entries.essence: Defensibility claims with no daily mechanism.
entries.apply: Fix via the moat ledger; build the mechanism or retire the claim.
entries.body:
Defensibility claims with no daily mechanism.
- **Apply**: Fix via the moat ledger; build the mechanism or retire the claim.

entries.name: The Premature Build
entries.essence: Capital intensity chosen before position durability is proven.
entries.apply: Fix via the sequencing mode and a reversibility budget.
entries.body:
Capital intensity chosen before position durability is proven.
- **Apply**: Fix via the sequencing mode and a reversibility budget.

entries.name: Renewal Hostage
entries.essence: A dependency discovered only at contract renewal.
entries.apply: Fix via the three-exposure inventory, run now.
entries.body:
A dependency discovered only at contract renewal.
- **Apply**: Fix via the three-exposure inventory, run now.

entries.name: Upstream Meter
entries.essence: Charging at content/features where flows route around the meter.
entries.apply: Fix by moving the meter to commitment, clearing, consumption, or residence.
entries.body:
Charging at content/features where flows route around the meter.
- **Apply**: Fix by moving the meter to commitment, clearing, consumption, or residence.

entries.name: Optionality Theater
entries.essence: "Options" that are slideware — nothing owned, nothing priced.
entries.apply: Fix by making options budget lines against named failure states.
entries.body:
"Options" that are slideware — nothing owned, nothing priced.
- **Apply**: Fix by making options budget lines against named failure states.

entries.name: Narrative-Peak Design
entries.essence: The firm designed at the top of a constraint story, on the eve of its rotation.
entries.apply: Fix via Layer 0 honestly; design against the structure.
entries.body:
The firm designed at the top of a constraint story, on the eve of its rotation.
- **Apply**: Fix via Layer 0 honestly; design against the structure.

entries.name: The Unfunded Killer
entries.essence: The discontinuous bet that obsoletes the design is funded only by competitors.
entries.apply: Fix via the second barbell; fund the bet that kills you.
entries.body:
The discontinuous bet that obsoletes the design is funded only by competitors.
- **Apply**: Fix via the second barbell; fund the bet that kills you.

entries.name: The Accident Mistaken for a Law
entries.essence: The software era rested on an accident it mistook for a law — that the marginal cost of a copy was zero. That was a property of the copy, not a law of business.
entries.apply: Whenever an "80% SaaS gross margin" assumption is imported into an AI business; name it as an accident that three inversions removed.
entries.body:
The software era rested on an accident it mistook for a law — that the marginal cost of a copy was zero. That was a property of the copy, not a law of business.
- **Apply**: Whenever an "80% SaaS gross margin" assumption is imported into an AI business; name it as an accident that three inversions removed.

entries.name: Marginal Cost Is Back
entries.essence: This era sells work, and work has a cost of goods; the marginal cost that vanished with the copy returns with the outcome.
entries.apply: Any time revenue is generated by producing work (tokens, outcomes) rather than shipping a copy — build a real COGS line.
entries.body:
This era sells work, and work has a cost of goods; the marginal cost that vanished with the copy returns with the outcome.
- **Apply**: Any time revenue is generated by producing work (tokens, outcomes) rather than shipping a copy — build a real COGS line.

entries.name: The Seat Broke From Both Ends
entries.essence: The per-seat pricing unit broke from both directions — consumption is heavy-tailed, so a median price loses money on the customers worth having; and agents complete work with no person to charge.
entries.apply: When evaluating or defending seat pricing for products with usage dispersion or agentic autonomy.
entries.body:
The per-seat pricing unit broke from both directions — consumption is heavy-tailed, so a median price loses money on the customers worth having; and agents complete work with no person to charge.
- **Apply**: When evaluating or defending seat pricing for products with usage dispersion or agentic autonomy.

entries.name: The Balance Sheet Moved
entries.essence: The capital to produce intelligence is committed years ahead on a physical clock and financed increasingly off the balance sheet — the P&L you read is not the capital you owe.
entries.apply: When reading any AI firm's financials; look past the income statement to commitments and off-balance-sheet financing.
entries.body:
The capital to produce intelligence is committed years ahead on a physical clock and financed increasingly off the balance sheet — the P&L you read is not the capital you owe.
- **Apply**: When reading any AI firm's financials; look past the income statement to commitments and off-balance-sheet financing.

entries.name: Software Acquires a Cost of Goods
entries.essence: Software, historically near-zero-COGS, now carries a genuine cost of goods sold because it performs work.
entries.apply: When modeling an AI software P&L — never assume the old margin structure.
entries.body:
Software, historically near-zero-COGS, now carries a genuine cost of goods sold because it performs work.
- **Apply**: When modeling an AI software P&L — never assume the old margin structure.

entries.name: The Counting Rule
entries.essence: Each end-customer dollar is counted once, at the tier the customer transacted with; lab compute bought from a cloud is the same dollar one step down, and neocloud revenue is a cost of the tiers above it, never incremental demand. Naive addition of published run-rates overstates by roughly 40–70%.
entries.apply: Stage 0 of any analysis touching published figures; run before believing any market number.
entries.body:
Each end-customer dollar is counted once, at the tier the customer transacted with; lab compute bought from a cloud is the same dollar one step down, and neocloud revenue is a cost of the tiers above it, never incremental demand. Naive addition of published run-rates overstates by roughly 40–70%.
- **Apply**: Stage 0 of any analysis touching published figures; run before believing any market number.

entries.name: The Double-Counted Tier
entries.essence: A failure pattern: lab revenue added to the cloud revenue that carried it — the same dollar counted twice across tiers.
entries.apply: When summing run-rates across labs / clouds / applications; trace each line to its transacting tier.
entries.body:
A failure pattern: lab revenue added to the cloud revenue that carried it — the same dollar counted twice across tiers.
- **Apply**: When summing run-rates across labs / clouds / applications; trace each line to its transacting tier.

entries.name: The Symmetric-Count Illusion
entries.essence: Counting capital broadly (across the whole build) while admitting revenue only where it transacts — a bias that runs in one fixed direction and is usually left unstated.
entries.apply: Whenever a hurdle or coverage figure is produced; name the asymmetry and its direction.
entries.body:
Counting capital broadly (across the whole build) while admitting revenue only where it transacts — a bias that runs in one fixed direction and is usually left unstated.
- **Apply**: Whenever a hurdle or coverage figure is produced; name the asymmetry and its direction.

entries.name: The Counting Asymmetry
entries.essence: Capital is estimated across the whole build; revenue is admitted only where it transacts; the largest capital program may have no external AI revenue at all — a fixed-direction bias the reader must be told about.
entries.apply: State it wherever the hurdle is computed; offer the two repairs (narrow the capital, or widen the return with an operating-surplus estimate).
entries.body:
Capital is estimated across the whole build; revenue is admitted only where it transacts; the largest capital program may have no external AI revenue at all — a fixed-direction bias the reader must be told about.
- **Apply**: State it wherever the hurdle is computed; offer the two repairs (narrow the capital, or widen the return with an operating-surplus estimate).

entries.name: Corroboration Must Be Independent
entries.essence: Two figures that share a margin assumption, a capital base, or a vintage agree by construction, not by corroboration; re-run any external method at current vintage before citing it.
entries.apply: Before treating any second number (e.g. "the $600B figure confirms it") as independent support.
entries.body:
Two figures that share a margin assumption, a capital base, or a vintage agree by construction, not by corroboration; re-run any external method at current vintage before citing it.
- **Apply**: Before treating any second number (e.g. "the $600B figure confirms it") as independent support.

entries.name: The Borrowed Corroboration
entries.essence: A failure pattern: citing an external figure of another vintage as if it independently confirms your own.
entries.apply: When leaning on Sequoia/JPMorgan-style external numbers; state vintage, method, and shared assumptions.
entries.body:
A failure pattern: citing an external figure of another vintage as if it independently confirms your own.
- **Apply**: When leaning on Sequoia/JPMorgan-style external numbers; state vintage, method, and shared assumptions.

entries.name: Never Divide a Stock by a Flow
entries.essence: Capex against revenue, forward obligation against an annual capital line, run-rate against a capital base — all category errors. Revenue is compared to depreciation; obligation to forward cash flow.
entries.apply: As the first red-team check on any ratio in the discipline.
entries.body:
Capex against revenue, forward obligation against an annual capital line, run-rate against a capital base — all category errors. Revenue is compared to depreciation; obligation to forward cash flow.
- **Apply**: As the first red-team check on any ratio in the discipline.

entries.name: The Stock-Over-Flow Error
entries.essence: The named failure of comparing a stock quantity to a flow quantity (the fix: revenue vs depreciation).
entries.apply: When someone puts capex against AI revenue on a board slide.
entries.body:
The named failure of comparing a stock quantity to a flow quantity (the fix: revenue vs depreciation).
- **Apply**: When someone puts capex against AI revenue on a board slide.

entries.name: Cost per Accepted Outcome
entries.essence: Tokens (in and out, at the model's price) + environment compute (sandboxes, retrieval, serving) + attention (human minutes at the loop's outer edge, at a loaded rate), over outcomes a referee accepted — not things produced.
entries.apply: Stage 1 of the engine; the base unit for every margin, price, and budget in the seat.
entries.body:
Tokens (in and out, at the model's price) + environment compute (sandboxes, retrieval, serving) + attention (human minutes at the loop's outer edge, at a loaded rate), over outcomes a referee accepted — not things produced.
- **Apply**: Stage 1 of the engine; the base unit for every margin, price, and budget in the seat.

entries.name: Budget on Tokens per Outcome
entries.essence: Budget intelligence in tokens per accepted outcome, never from a price table — token prices go stale within a quarter.
entries.apply: Building any forward AI budget or line item; refuse "budget at today's token prices."
entries.body:
Budget intelligence in tokens per accepted outcome, never from a price table — token prices go stale within a quarter.
- **Apply**: Building any forward AI budget or line item; refuse "budget at today's token prices."

entries.name: The Deflation Paradox
entries.essence: When modeling a model-price cut, work tokens-per-task first and price second — never price alone; falling unit prices can be offset (or overwhelmed) by rising tokens per task.
entries.apply: "Model the impact of a model-price cut" routes here first, before any repricing.
entries.body:
When modeling a model-price cut, work tokens-per-task first and price second — never price alone; falling unit prices can be offset (or overwhelmed) by rising tokens per task.
- **Apply**: "Model the impact of a model-price cut" routes here first, before any repricing.

entries.name: Heavy-Tailed Consumption
entries.essence: Consumption is heavily skewed — the top few percent of users can consume the majority of tokens, so a price set to the median loses money on the customers worth having.
entries.apply: Diagnosing per-customer losses; compute cost per accepted outcome for the top decile and median separately (the answer is usually distributional, not level).
entries.body:
Consumption is heavily skewed — the top few percent of users can consume the majority of tokens, so a price set to the median loses money on the customers worth having.
- **Apply**: Diagnosing per-customer losses; compute cost per accepted outcome for the top decile and median separately (the answer is usually distributional, not level).

entries.name: The Median-User Price
entries.essence: A failure pattern: pricing to the median user in a heavy-tailed distribution (the fix: price the tail).
entries.apply: When a flat price is losing money on power users.
entries.body:
A failure pattern: pricing to the median user in a heavy-tailed distribution (the fix: price the tail).
- **Apply**: When a flat price is losing money on power users.

entries.name: The Physics of the Cost Line
entries.essence: The cost line obeys real physics — tokens, watts, compute, human minutes — not the frictionless economics of the copy.
entries.apply: When reasoning about where cost actually comes from before proposing to move it.
entries.body:
The cost line obeys real physics — tokens, watts, compute, human minutes — not the frictionless economics of the copy.
- **Apply**: When reasoning about where cost actually comes from before proposing to move it.

entries.name: Gross Margin as a Design Outcome
entries.essence: Gross margin stops being a property of the category and becomes a design outcome — recovery comes from deliberate levers, not from scale.
entries.apply: Whenever margins are weak; refuse "model our margin at 80%" and build it from the levers.
entries.body:
Gross margin stops being a property of the category and becomes a design outcome — recovery comes from deliberate levers, not from scale.
- **Apply**: Whenever margins are weak; refuse "model our margin at 80%" and build it from the levers.

entries.name: The Four Levers
entries.essence: The four finance-owned, metered levers of margin: the routing table (task class → model → price), the cache hit rate, the owned-model share (residue trained into weights), and attention per outcome.
entries.apply: Stage 2 margin design; the slide when explaining margin to the board.
entries.body:
The four finance-owned, metered levers of margin: the routing table (task class → model → price), the cache hit rate, the owned-model share (residue trained into weights), and attention per outcome.
- **Apply**: Stage 2 margin design; the slide when explaining margin to the board.

entries.name: Ceiling vs Company Average
entries.essence: A ceiling on well-used capacity is not the company average across the whole revenue mix — the two must never be mistaken for each other.
entries.apply: Any margin claim; hold the best-case unit figure apart from the blended company figure explicitly.
entries.body:
A ceiling on well-used capacity is not the company average across the whole revenue mix — the two must never be mistaken for each other.
- **Apply**: Any margin claim; hold the best-case unit figure apart from the blended company figure explicitly.

entries.name: The Ceiling at Seventy
entries.essence: A named ceiling reference — the gross-margin ceiling that well-used inference capacity tends toward, distinct from the company average.
entries.apply: When benchmarking an inference margin against its structural limit.
entries.body:
A named ceiling reference — the gross-margin ceiling that well-used inference capacity tends toward, distinct from the company average.
- **Apply**: When benchmarking an inference margin against its structural limit.

entries.name: Revenue per Megawatt / Tokens per Watt
entries.essence: Physical-unit efficiency metrics reading revenue and token throughput against the power a build consumes.
entries.apply: Reading lab/datacenter unit economics where the binding constraint is power, not headcount.
entries.body:
Physical-unit efficiency metrics reading revenue and token throughput against the power a build consumes.
- **Apply**: Reading lab/datacenter unit economics where the binding constraint is power, not headcount.

entries.name: The SaaS-Margin Assumption
entries.essence: A failure pattern: assuming zero-marginal-cost SaaS margins in an AI business (the fix: margin as design).
entries.apply: When a plan pencils 80% gross margin by default.
entries.body:
A failure pattern: assuming zero-marginal-cost SaaS margins in an AI business (the fix: margin as design).
- **Apply**: When a plan pencils 80% gross margin by default.

entries.name: Pricing as a Finance Instrument
entries.essence: Price is set on a grid of attribution × autonomy — seats where the system assists, usage where autonomy runs without clean attribution, outcomes where a verifiable result is owned and unlocked by proof.
entries.apply: Stage 3; every pricing/packaging decision (seats vs usage vs outcomes vs credits).
entries.body:
Price is set on a grid of attribution × autonomy — seats where the system assists, usage where autonomy runs without clean attribution, outcomes where a verifiable result is owned and unlocked by proof.
- **Apply**: Stage 3; every pricing/packaging decision (seats vs usage vs outcomes vs credits).

entries.name: Never Seat-Price Agentic Value
entries.essence: Seat pricing caps revenue at the customer's headcount precisely where the product removes the seat's work — so agentic scope must not be seat-priced.
entries.apply: Refuse "price it per seat" for agentic products; move to the grid.
entries.body:
Seat pricing caps revenue at the customer's headcount precisely where the product removes the seat's work — so agentic scope must not be seat-priced.
- **Apply**: Refuse "price it per seat" for agentic products; move to the grid.

entries.name: Price the Tail
entries.essence: Price the heavy-tailed high-consumption cohort with multiples of usage rather than a flat rate; when a price must move, move the tail first and the base last.
entries.apply: Repricing a heavy-tailed product; protecting the base while recovering margin from power users.
entries.body:
Price the heavy-tailed high-consumption cohort with multiples of usage rather than a flat rate; when a price must move, move the tail first and the base last.
- **Apply**: Repricing a heavy-tailed product; protecting the base while recovering margin from power users.

entries.name: Hybrids Are the Transition
entries.essence: Hybrids (seat → credits/usage → outcomes) are the transition; outcome pricing is the end state; each step has conditions that must be true before it is taken.
entries.apply: Designing a pricing migration path with staged triggers.
entries.body:
Hybrids (seat → credits/usage → outcomes) are the transition; outcome pricing is the end state; each step has conditions that must be true before it is taken.
- **Apply**: Designing a pricing migration path with staged triggers.

entries.name: The Guarantee Has a Cost Wherever It Sits
entries.essence: An outcome/result guarantee always carries a cost — outcome pricing without a verification instrument is merely a dispute schedule.
entries.apply: Before offering outcome terms; require the verification instrument first.
entries.body:
An outcome/result guarantee always carries a cost — outcome pricing without a verification instrument is merely a dispute schedule.
- **Apply**: Before offering outcome terms; require the verification instrument first.

entries.name: The Compounding Curve (for the buyer)
entries.essence: Show the buyer the curve where unit price falls as the substrate matures while account value rises.
entries.apply: In the sales/pricing narrative for a maturing agentic product.
entries.body:
Show the buyer the curve where unit price falls as the substrate matures while account value rises.
- **Apply**: In the sales/pricing narrative for a maturing agentic product.

entries.name: The Free User Is a Cost
entries.essence: In an era with real COGS, the free user is a cost, not a marketing asset — the free wedge must be sized to a verified outcome and no further.
entries.apply: Costing a free tier; sizing the wedge in growth accounting.
entries.body:
In an era with real COGS, the free user is a cost, not a marketing asset — the free wedge must be sized to a verified outcome and no further.
- **Apply**: Costing a free tier; sizing the wedge in growth accounting.

entries.name: AI-Era LTV / CAC / Payback
entries.essence: LTV carries a cost of goods per period; CAC is recomputed for citation-and-endpoint acquisition; payback is keyed to time-to-magic — the cohort table shows margin, not just revenue.
entries.apply: Any cohort, retention, or acquisition-economics analysis in the AI era.
entries.body:
LTV carries a cost of goods per period; CAC is recomputed for citation-and-endpoint acquisition; payback is keyed to time-to-magic — the cohort table shows margin, not just revenue.
- **Apply**: Any cohort, retention, or acquisition-economics analysis in the AI era.

entries.name: The Free-Tier Bill
entries.essence: A failure pattern: an uncosted free tier arriving as a real bill (the fix: wedge sized to an outcome).
entries.apply: When free-user compute is unmodeled in the plan.
entries.body:
A failure pattern: an uncosted free tier arriving as a real bill (the fix: wedge sized to an outcome).
- **Apply**: When free-user compute is unmodeled in the plan.

entries.name: The Three Tests
entries.essence: Read capital with three tests that disagree, and the disagreement is the answer — the income-statement test (revenue vs recognized depreciation), the capital test (the hurdle), and the funding test (external share and whether the character of the money changed).
entries.apply: "Is the buildout sustainable / is this a bubble / capex vs revenue"; refuse the single-ratio question.
entries.body:
Read capital with three tests that disagree, and the disagreement is the answer — the income-statement test (revenue vs recognized depreciation), the capital test (the hurdle), and the funding test (external share and whether the character of the money changed).
- **Apply**: "Is the buildout sustainable / is this a bubble / capex vs revenue"; refuse the single-ratio question.

entries.name: Revenue Against Depreciation, Not Capex
entries.essence: Revenue is compared to recognized depreciation, never to capex; the coverage ratio is revenue ÷ recognized D&A.
entries.apply: Replacing any capex-against-revenue exhibit; the fast-lane board fix.
entries.body:
Revenue is compared to recognized depreciation, never to capex; the coverage ratio is revenue ÷ recognized D&A.
- **Apply**: Replacing any capex-against-revenue exhibit; the fast-lane board fix.

entries.name: The Hurdle Is Arithmetic
entries.essence: Required annual revenue = deployed base × (1/blended life + cost of capital) ÷ gross margin — a division shown with every input, not a judgment call.
entries.apply: "What return does this capital need"; compute with full inputs and a sensitivity band.
entries.body:
Required annual revenue = deployed base × (1/blended life + cost of capital) ÷ gross margin — a division shown with every input, not a judgment call.
- **Apply**: "What return does this capital need"; compute with full inputs and a sensitivity band.

entries.name: The Beat Raises the Hurdle
entries.essence: A record quarter at a supplier enlarges the capital base that must earn a return, so it raises the end-customer revenue the layers above must eventually produce — a silicon-layer beat is evidence against the monetization case, not for it.
entries.apply: When a supplier "just printed"; add the note to any hurdle.
entries.body:
A record quarter at a supplier enlarges the capital base that must earn a return, so it raises the end-customer revenue the layers above must eventually produce — a silicon-layer beat is evidence against the monetization case, not for it.
- **Apply**: When a supplier "just printed"; add the note to any hurdle.

entries.name: The Income Statement Answers Before the Maturity Schedule Asks
entries.essence: The operating economics (revenue vs depreciation, coverage) resolve the sustainability question before the debt maturity schedule even poses it.
entries.apply: Sequencing a capital read — start at the income statement, not the maturity wall.
entries.body:
The operating economics (revenue vs depreciation, coverage) resolve the sustainability question before the debt maturity schedule even poses it.
- **Apply**: Sequencing a capital read — start at the income statement, not the maturity wall.

entries.name: Growth Requirements Are Compounded, Not Averaged
entries.essence: A charge heading to 3× over three years requires revenue to triple — ~44% a year (3^(1/3)=1.442), not the 40% an average returns; check every growth claim against its own exponent.
entries.apply: Any multi-year growth requirement; note when the error flatters the case.
entries.body:
A charge heading to 3× over three years requires revenue to triple — ~44% a year (3^(1/3)=1.442), not the 40% an average returns; check every growth claim against its own exponent.
- **Apply**: Any multi-year growth requirement; note when the error flatters the case.

entries.name: The Uncompounded Growth Requirement
entries.essence: A failure pattern: averaging a growth requirement that should be compounded.
entries.apply: When a tripling is quoted as ~40%/yr.
entries.body:
A failure pattern: averaging a growth requirement that should be compounded.
- **Apply**: When a tripling is quoted as ~40%/yr.

entries.name: Split by Clock
entries.essence: Capital splits by clock — short-lived vs long-lived, financeable vs pledgeable — read as one pipe into two vessels with two clock faces.
entries.apply: Stage 5; any capex composition or depreciation analysis.
entries.body:
Capital splits by clock — short-lived vs long-lived, financeable vs pledgeable — read as one pipe into two vessels with two clock faces.
- **Apply**: Stage 5; any capex composition or depreciation analysis.

entries.name: Depreciation-Weighted Life
entries.essence: With mixed asset lives the annual charge is the sum of each share divided by its own life, and the blended life is that sum's reciprocal — 60% at 5 years and 40% at 25 gives ~13.6%/yr and a life near 7.35, not the ~13 years arithmetic averaging returns.
entries.apply: Any blended asset-life figure; state the weighting method inline.
entries.body:
With mixed asset lives the annual charge is the sum of each share divided by its own life, and the blended life is that sum's reciprocal — 60% at 5 years and 40% at 25 gives ~13.6%/yr and a life near 7.35, not the ~13 years arithmetic averaging returns.
- **Apply**: Any blended asset-life figure; state the weighting method inline.

entries.name: The Arithmetic Asset Life
entries.essence: A failure pattern: averaging asset lives arithmetically instead of depreciation-weighting them.
entries.apply: When a blended life is quoted without its weighting method.
entries.body:
A failure pattern: averaging asset lives arithmetically instead of depreciation-weighting them.
- **Apply**: When a blended life is quoted without its weighting method.

entries.name: Price Is Not Capacity
entries.essence: The price-not-capacity share distinguishes what the capital bought in capability from what it merely paid in price — capacity and its cost are separate readings.
entries.apply: Reading a capital program's composition; isolate genuine capacity from price inflation.
entries.body:
The price-not-capacity share distinguishes what the capital bought in capability from what it merely paid in price — capacity and its cost are separate readings.
- **Apply**: Reading a capital program's composition; isolate genuine capacity from price inflation.

entries.name: Financeable vs Pledgeable
entries.essence: Assets differ in whether they can be financed and whether they can be pledged as collateral — a structural property that shapes the capital program.
entries.apply: Assessing how a build is or can be funded.
entries.body:
Assets differ in whether they can be financed and whether they can be pledged as collateral — a structural property that shapes the capital program.
- **Apply**: Assessing how a build is or can be funded.

entries.name: The Acid Test
entries.essence: Six gauges on one rail — structure ratio, velocity spread, external dependence, coverage, counterparty floor, take-out gap — where the finding is the spread across them, not the composite; every concealment gauge needs a cash-flow denominator.
entries.apply: Debt, leases, off-balance-sheet, financing structure; run quarterly on the firm's own commitments.
entries.body:
Six gauges on one rail — structure ratio, velocity spread, external dependence, coverage, counterparty floor, take-out gap — where the finding is the spread across them, not the composite; every concealment gauge needs a cash-flow denominator.
- **Apply**: Debt, leases, off-balance-sheet, financing structure; run quarterly on the firm's own commitments.

entries.name: Read the Spread, Not the Composite
entries.essence: On the acid test's six-gauge rail, the diagnostic signal is the dispersion between gauges, not their average.
entries.apply: Interpreting the acid-test rail; risk-weight by deferral vs transfer.
entries.body:
On the acid test's six-gauge rail, the diagnostic signal is the dispersion between gauges, not their average.
- **Apply**: Interpreting the acid-test rail; risk-weight by deferral vs transfer.

entries.name: The Off-Balance-Sheet Blind Spot
entries.essence: A failure pattern: missing financing that sits off the balance sheet (the fix: the acid test, run quarterly).
entries.apply: When a firm's leases-not-commenced, guarantees, or SPV financing go unread.
entries.body:
A failure pattern: missing financing that sits off the balance sheet (the fix: the acid test, run quarterly).
- **Apply**: When a firm's leases-not-commenced, guarantees, or SPV financing go unread.

entries.name: Allocation Becomes Obligation
entries.essence: A capital allocation entering the plan turns into a hard obligation downstream — drawn as a river entering a lock and splitting into obligation channels.
entries.apply: Tracing how committed spend hardens into contractual liability.
entries.body:
A capital allocation entering the plan turns into a hard obligation downstream — drawn as a river entering a lock and splitting into obligation channels.
- **Apply**: Tracing how committed spend hardens into contractual liability.

entries.name: Pre-Funding Makes the Near Term Sticky
entries.essence: Capital raised ahead of need makes the near-term commitments sticky — the money is already spoken for regardless of demand.
entries.apply: Assessing near-term flexibility of a pre-funded build.
entries.body:
Capital raised ahead of need makes the near-term commitments sticky — the money is already spoken for regardless of demand.
- **Apply**: Assessing near-term flexibility of a pre-funded build.

entries.name: The Bottom Line Believed
entries.essence: A failure pattern: reading net income (moved by marks on stakes) as if it were operations — read the operating line before believing any bottom line.
entries.apply: When marks on customer/supplier stakes flatter or punish net income.
entries.body:
A failure pattern: reading net income (moved by marks on stakes) as if it were operations — read the operating line before believing any bottom line.
- **Apply**: When marks on customer/supplier stakes flatter or punish net income.

entries.name: Net Income Has Two Engines
entries.essence: Net income is driven by two distinct engines — the operation, and marks on stakes in customers and suppliers that touch the bottom line without touching operations.
entries.apply: Separating operating performance from valuation effects in any P&L read.
entries.body:
Net income is driven by two distinct engines — the operation, and marks on stakes in customers and suppliers that touch the bottom line without touching operations.
- **Apply**: Separating operating performance from valuation effects in any P&L read.

entries.name: The Layer Map Is Not the Credit Map
entries.essence: Value's horizontal geometry (the layer map) is a different object from contagion's vertical geometry (the credit map); confusing them hides risk.
entries.apply: Mapping counterparty/contagion risk against the value stack.
entries.body:
Value's horizontal geometry (the layer map) is a different object from contagion's vertical geometry (the credit map); confusing them hides risk.
- **Apply**: Mapping counterparty/contagion risk against the value stack.

entries.name: The Three Joints
entries.essence: The specific points where the layer map crosses the credit map are the joints where stress transmits — read alongside the phase calendar and a watchlist by information value.
entries.apply: "Counterparty risk, contagion, credit vs layers"; build the joint table and calendar.
entries.body:
The specific points where the layer map crosses the credit map are the joints where stress transmits — read alongside the phase calendar and a watchlist by information value.
- **Apply**: "Counterparty risk, contagion, credit vs layers"; build the joint table and calendar.

entries.name: It Breaks Upward
entries.essence: The order of operations in a stress event: it breaks upward through the stack.
entries.apply: Sequencing how a failure propagates across tiers.
entries.body:
The order of operations in a stress event: it breaks upward through the stack.
- **Apply**: Sequencing how a failure propagates across tiers.

entries.name: The Amplifier, Not the Bubble
entries.essence: The question "is it a bubble" is malformed for a stack on four clocks; the structure acts as an amplifier — run the acid test and read the spread instead.
entries.apply: Refuse "just tell me if it's a bubble"; reframe to the tests and the spread.
entries.body:
The question "is it a bubble" is malformed for a stack on four clocks; the structure acts as an amplifier — run the acid test and read the spread instead.
- **Apply**: Refuse "just tell me if it's a bubble"; reframe to the tests and the spread.

entries.name: Absorption Capacity
entries.essence: Each builder is placed on a ladder by capital intensity and funding source — the measure of whether it can afford its build.
entries.apply: "Can this company afford its build"; place the builder on a rung.
entries.body:
Each builder is placed on a ladder by capital intensity and funding source — the measure of whether it can afford its build.
- **Apply**: "Can this company afford its build"; place the builder on a rung.

entries.name: Operating Absorption Is Not Cash Absorption
entries.essence: A firm's ability to absorb a build operationally (through the P&L) is distinct from its ability to absorb it in cash — read the two separately.
entries.apply: Assessing build affordability; never conflate operating and cash absorption.
entries.body:
A firm's ability to absorb a build operationally (through the P&L) is distinct from its ability to absorb it in cash — read the two separately.
- **Apply**: Assessing build affordability; never conflate operating and cash absorption.

entries.name: The Control Group
entries.essence: A builder's absorption is judged against a control-group comparison, not in isolation.
entries.apply: Benchmarking one builder's capital intensity and funding against peers.
entries.body:
A builder's absorption is judged against a control-group comparison, not in isolation.
- **Apply**: Benchmarking one builder's capital intensity and funding against peers.

entries.name: The Five Incidence Paths
entries.essence: An AI bill arrives on one of five paths — capitalized, memory tax, discovery tax, traffic-carry, or inference as COGS — each landing on a specific P&L line with a specific defense.
entries.apply: "This isn't our build — why is it in our P&L"; name the path and its instrument.
entries.body:
An AI bill arrives on one of five paths — capitalized, memory tax, discovery tax, traffic-carry, or inference as COGS — each landing on a specific P&L line with a specific defense.
- **Apply**: "This isn't our build — why is it in our P&L"; name the path and its instrument.

entries.name: The Data Oil
entries.essence: Proprietary data behaves like an oil reserve — wells, a refinery, and a late royalty — a resource whose value is extracted and monetized downstream over time.
entries.apply: Valuing or reasoning about a firm's proprietary data as a capital asset.
entries.body:
Proprietary data behaves like an oil reserve — wells, a refinery, and a late royalty — a resource whose value is extracted and monetized downstream over time.
- **Apply**: Valuing or reasoning about a firm's proprietary data as a capital asset.

entries.name: The Second Barrel
entries.essence: The second monetization of the same data resource — a further royalty extracted from an already-drilled reserve.
entries.apply: When a data asset is monetized more than once.
entries.body:
The second monetization of the same data resource — a further royalty extracted from an already-drilled reserve.
- **Apply**: When a data asset is monetized more than once.

entries.name: The Supplier Joins the Clock
entries.essence: When a supplier's own financing channels (equity stakes, receivables, guarantees, syndicated platforms) fund the buildout, the supplier becomes part of the capital clock and needs its own column in the acid test.
entries.apply: Reading supply-side financing invisible to a hyperscaler-built six-gauge test.
entries.body:
When a supplier's own financing channels (equity stakes, receivables, guarantees, syndicated platforms) fund the buildout, the supplier becomes part of the capital clock and needs its own column in the acid test.
- **Apply**: Reading supply-side financing invisible to a hyperscaler-built six-gauge test.

entries.name: The Levered Backer
entries.essence: A named actor: a backer funding the build with leverage, adding a financing channel to the contagion map.
entries.apply: Mapping who carries the leverage behind a builder.
entries.body:
A named actor: a backer funding the build with leverage, adding a financing channel to the contagion map.
- **Apply**: Mapping who carries the leverage behind a builder.

entries.name: The Wrapper
entries.essence: A named actor/structure: the wrapper around underlying AI exposure that repackages or intermediates the risk.
entries.apply: Identifying repackaged exposure in the credit map.
entries.body:
A named actor/structure: the wrapper around underlying AI exposure that repackages or intermediates the risk.
- **Apply**: Identifying repackaged exposure in the credit map.

entries.name: Real, Historic, and Insufficient
entries.essence: A verdict frame: the AI buildout can be simultaneously real, historic in scale, and insufficient to clear its own hurdle — all three at once.
entries.apply: Summarizing a capital-program verdict without collapsing into "bubble / not bubble."
entries.body:
A verdict frame: the AI buildout can be simultaneously real, historic in scale, and insufficient to clear its own hurdle — all three at once.
- **Apply**: Summarizing a capital-program verdict without collapsing into "bubble / not bubble."

entries.name: The Ledger the Firm Writes Itself
entries.essence: The M5 end state: the ledger is the firm's own — budgets in tokens per outcome, the board reads revenue against depreciation, and the counting asymmetry is stated in the firm's own materials.
entries.apply: Setting the maturity target for a finance function.
entries.body:
The M5 end state: the ledger is the firm's own — budgets in tokens per outcome, the board reads revenue against depreciation, and the counting asymmetry is stated in the firm's own materials.
- **Apply**: Setting the maturity target for a finance function.

entries.name: Stage 0 — Establish the Count
entries.essence: Name the tiers (labs / clouds / applications / the uncountable), apply the counting rule (count once at the transacting tier, strip lab compute from cloud AI revenue, exclude neocloud revenue as a cost), mark each input disclosed/reported/estimated with its date, and produce a range.
entries.apply: First stage of any analysis touching published figures.
entries.body:
Name the tiers (labs / clouds / applications / the uncountable), apply the counting rule (count once at the transacting tier, strip lab compute from cloud AI revenue, exclude neocloud revenue as a cost), mark each input disclosed/reported/estimated with its date, and produce a range.
- **Apply**: First stage of any analysis touching published figures.

entries.name: Stage 1 — Build the Unit
entries.essence: Compute cost per accepted outcome (tokens + environment compute + attention over referee-accepted outcomes), trend it as the learning curve, and bridge it to COGS and gross margin.
entries.apply: Establishing per-unit profitability before pricing or margin work.
entries.body:
Compute cost per accepted outcome (tokens + environment compute + attention over referee-accepted outcomes), trend it as the learning curve, and bridge it to COGS and gross margin.
- **Apply**: Establishing per-unit profitability before pricing or margin work.

entries.name: Stage 2 — Design the Margin
entries.essence: Move margin with the four finance-owned levers (routing table, cache hit rate, owned-model share, attention per outcome); distinguish the ceiling from the company average.
entries.apply: After the unit is built and margin is weak.
entries.body:
Move margin with the four finance-owned levers (routing table, cache hit rate, owned-model share, attention per outcome); distinguish the ceiling from the company average.
- **Apply**: After the unit is built and margin is weak.

entries.name: Stage 3 — Set the Price
entries.essence: Place price on the attribution × autonomy grid, price the tail with multiples of usage, show the buyer the compounding curve, and stage hybrids toward outcome pricing (with the verification instrument).
entries.apply: After margin is designed; any pricing/packaging decision.
entries.body:
Place price on the attribution × autonomy grid, price the tail with multiples of usage, show the buyer the compounding curve, and stage hybrids toward outcome pricing (with the verification instrument).
- **Apply**: After margin is designed; any pricing/packaging decision.

entries.name: Stage 4 — Read the Capital
entries.essence: Run the three tests (income statement, capital/hurdle, funding) that disagree — the disagreement is the answer.
entries.apply: Assessing capital sustainability and required return.
entries.body:
Run the three tests (income statement, capital/hurdle, funding) that disagree — the disagreement is the answer.
- **Apply**: Assessing capital sustainability and required return.

entries.name: Stage 5 — Read the Structure
entries.essence: Split by clock, run the acid test's six gauges (read the spread), map the joints where the layer and credit maps cross, place each builder on the absorption ladder, then answer the incidence question.
entries.apply: Structural/systemic reading after the capital is read.
entries.body:
Split by clock, run the acid test's six gauges (read the spread), map the joints where the layer and credit maps cross, place each builder on the absorption ladder, then answer the incidence question.
- **Apply**: Structural/systemic reading after the capital is read.

entries.name: THE COUNT
entries.essence: Build revenue by tier with low/central/high and a source class per input, show the strip-and-exclude operations, produce the total with its range, and name the weakest input.
entries.apply: Any request touching a market number, run-rate, or published figure — runs first before any other mode.
entries.body:
Build revenue by tier with low/central/high and a source class per input, show the strip-and-exclude operations, produce the total with its range, and name the weakest input.
- **Apply**: Any request touching a market number, run-rate, or published figure — runs first before any other mode.

entries.name: UNIT ECONOMICS
entries.essence: Cost per accepted outcome with its three components separated, the acceptance definition (referee and threshold), the trend, and the bridge to COGS and gross margin.
entries.apply: "What does this cost / are we profitable per unit / token spend."
entries.body:
Cost per accepted outcome with its three components separated, the acceptance definition (referee and threshold), the trend, and the bridge to COGS and gross margin.
- **Apply**: "What does this cost / are we profitable per unit / token spend."

entries.name: MARGIN DESIGN
entries.essence: Decompose current margin, read the four levers at current and target, propose the routing table, the cache opportunity, the owned-model case, and the margin bridge — no improvement from scale alone.
entries.apply: "Our margins are bad / how do we get to positive gross margin."
entries.body:
Decompose current margin, read the four levers at current and target, propose the routing table, the cache opportunity, the owned-model case, and the margin bridge — no improvement from scale alone.
- **Apply**: "Our margins are bad / how do we get to positive gross margin."

entries.name: PRICING ARCHITECT
entries.essence: Grid placement, the proof-unlocked ladder, tail pricing, the hybrid transition path, and the buyer's compounding curve — never seat-price agentic value; outcome terms require the instrument.
entries.apply: Pricing, packaging, seats vs usage vs outcomes, credits.

entries.name: Layer 0 — Work Physics
entries.essence: Answers "what is the work, really?" Decompose the scope into flows (a flow = a recurring unit of work with an input, a transformation, and an output someone consumes) and score each on three dimensions — Volume, Specifiability, Consequence (severity and reversibility) — then assign an automation category.
entries.apply: Use to build the work map and draw the automation frontier. Category rule: Automate-first = H/M volume + Y spec + L/M-reversible consequence; Automate-with-gate = Y/PARTIAL spec + any consequence (junction mandatory); Judgment work = N spec or H-irreversible; Leave manual = L volume. Unspecifiable work cannot be gated, and ungateable work must not be autonomous.

entries.apply: Use to find structural gaps in automated units. Run the four audit tests in order of diagnostic power: the charter test, the swap test, the method test, the record test. Score 0–2 per test (/8) and surface the top structural gaps.

entries.apply: Use whenever human-in-the-loop, oversight, or approval steps are in scope. Fewer than five written specs = the junction is decorative. Above ~85% utilization = rubber stamp; below ~20% = consider consolidation. Output the junction ledger.

entries.apply: Use to audit structural durability at scale. Blast radii containing customer-visible or irreversible actions with zero intermediate checks are the finding that outranks all others. Output the topology verdict.

entries.name: The Orchestration Maturity Ladder
entries.essence: A six-level scale for scoring a scope — L0 Ad hoc (individuals use AI, no charters/junctions/record), L1 Piloted (named use cases, demos, nothing instrumented), L2 Chartered (units have charters and owners, junctions unsized, corrections partly captured), L3 Instrumented (frozen evals, sized junctions, current roster, autonomy by thresholds, six gauges live), L4 Governed (full cadence, topology rules enforced, refusal log maintained, bench plan funded), L5 Compounding (loop measurably improves quarter over quarter, property share rising, operating model a stated competitive asset with receipts).
entries.apply: Score the scope, state the level and the gap to the next. Most firms claiming "AI-first" audit at L1; the jump that pays is L1→L3, and it runs through charters and evals, not better models.
entries.body:
A six-level scale for scoring a scope — L0 Ad hoc (individuals use AI, no charters/junctions/record), L1 Piloted (named use cases, demos, nothing instrumented), L2 Chartered (units have charters and owners, junctions unsized, corrections partly captured), L3 Instrumented (frozen evals, sized junctions, current roster, autonomy by thresholds, six gauges live), L4 Governed (full cadence, topology rules enforced, refusal log maintained, bench plan funded), L5 Compounding (loop measurably improves quarter over quarter, property share rising, operating model a stated competitive asset with receipts).
- **Apply**: Score the scope, state the level and the gap to the next. Most firms claiming "AI-first" audit at L1; the jump that pays is L1→L3, and it runs through charters and evals, not better models.
