The expert's taste is encoded once — into documentation, reviewer prompts, and mechanical checks — instead of depending on the person's live review each time.
- **Apply**: Use to break single-reviewer dependency; encode the senior's judgment into artifacts.

entries.name: The Glass Cockpit
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: The harness exposes queryable telemetry so the state of work is instrumented and visible.
entries.apply: Instrument the ground so gauges and telemetry are readable by agent and human.
entries.body:
The harness exposes queryable telemetry so the state of work is instrumented and visible.
- **Apply**: Instrument the ground so gauges and telemetry are readable by agent and human.

entries.name: What It Cannot See Does Not Exist
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: Anything outside the agent's readable record and window effectively does not exist for it.
entries.apply: The record law — migrate all load-bearing knowledge into files agents can read.
entries.body:
Anything outside the agent's readable record and window effectively does not exist for it.
- **Apply**: The record law — migrate all load-bearing knowledge into files agents can read.

entries.name: The Gardened Record
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: The record is kept live by ongoing gardening — index checks, cross-link checks, freshness verification, and an agent cadence that opens fix-ups.
entries.apply: Install liveness machinery and a gardening cadence; a record without upkeep rots.
entries.body:
The record is kept live by ongoing gardening — index checks, cross-link checks, freshness verification, and an agent cadence that opens fix-ups.
- **Apply**: Install liveness machinery and a gardening cadence; a record without upkeep rots.

entries.name: The Taste Hierarchy
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: Quality rules ascend three levels — documentation → reviewer-enforced → mechanical — and each rule sits at the level its load-bearing weight warrants.
entries.apply: Classify and promote rules up the hierarchy; the distribution across levels is itself a finding.
entries.body:
Quality rules ascend three levels — documentation → reviewer-enforced → mechanical — and each rule sits at the level its load-bearing weight warrants.
- **Apply**: Classify and promote rules up the hierarchy; the distribution across levels is itself a finding.

entries.name: Invariants, Not Implementations
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: Encode the invariant (fix the boundary) and free the inside; do not over-specify how work is done.
entries.apply: When encoding standards, constrain outcomes/boundaries, not internal methods.
entries.body:
Encode the invariant (fix the boundary) and free the inside; do not over-specify how work is done.
- **Apply**: When encoding standards, constrain outcomes/boundaries, not internal methods.

entries.name: The Error Message Is a Prompt
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: A check's remediation text is the deliverable — it must say what is wrong, why the rule exists, and what to do instead; a check that says only "failed" wastes the era's best-timed instruction slot.
entries.apply: Write every mechanical check's error text as a corrective prompt.
entries.body:
A check's remediation text is the deliverable — it must say what is wrong, why the rule exists, and what to do instead; a check that says only "failed" wastes the era's best-timed instruction slot.
- **Apply**: Write every mechanical check's error text as a corrective prompt.

entries.name: Window First, Model Last
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: The mandatory diagnosis order — window first, retrieval second, loops third, the model last.
entries.apply: Enforce in every failure diagnosis; reject diagnoses that begin with switching models.
entries.body:
The mandatory diagnosis order — window first, retrieval second, loops third, the model last.
- **Apply**: Enforce in every failure diagnosis; reject diagnoses that begin with switching models.

entries.name: Legibility Through Sameness
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: Sameness across work makes it legible and reviewable; consistent structure lowers the cost of trust.
entries.apply: Standardize forms and conventions so output can be verified at a glance.
entries.body:
Sameness across work makes it legible and reviewable; consistent structure lowers the cost of trust.
- **Apply**: Standardize forms and conventions so output can be verified at a glance.

entries.name: Early Heavy Structure
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: Put structure in early — heavy up front — because it pays off across all subsequent work.
entries.apply: In greenfield design, front-load the map, record, gates, and permissions before scaling volume.
entries.body:
Put structure in early — heavy up front — because it pays off across all subsequent work.
- **Apply**: In greenfield design, front-load the map, record, gates, and permissions before scaling volume.

entries.name: Corrections Cheap, Waiting Expensive
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: Making and encoding corrections is cheap relative to the cost of waiting; act on drift and mistakes promptly.
entries.apply: Bias toward fast follow-up fixes over held queues; encode corrections rather than deferring.
entries.body:
Making and encoding corrections is cheap relative to the cost of waiting; act on drift and mistakes promptly.
- **Apply**: Bias toward fast follow-up fixes over held queues; encode corrections rather than deferring.

entries.name: Garbage Collection Is a Subsystem
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: Entropy management is a standing subsystem — named drift classes, categorical elimination, standing sweeps, and the twice-is-expensive maturity test — not an ad hoc cleanup.
entries.apply: Install as a running cadence (e.g., a standing sweep); treat drift as a category to eliminate, not an instance to patch.
entries.body:
Entropy management is a standing subsystem — named drift classes, categorical elimination, standing sweeps, and the twice-is-expensive maturity test — not an ad hoc cleanup.
- **Apply**: Install as a running cadence (e.g., a standing sweep); treat drift as a category to eliminate, not an instance to patch.

entries.name: Attention Spend
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: The master gauge — human minutes per accepted outcome; the outcome the whole harness exists to lower.
entries.apply: Track as the top-line metric; every harness improvement should reduce it.
entries.body:
The master gauge — human minutes per accepted outcome; the outcome the whole harness exists to lower.
- **Apply**: Track as the top-line metric; every harness improvement should reduce it.

entries.name: The Unattended Horizon
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: The longest stretch the harness carries work without a human touch — hours at H4, days at H5.
entries.apply: Use as a maturity signal and a target; lengthen it by closing loops and migrating trust.
entries.body:
The longest stretch the harness carries work without a human touch — hours at H4, days at H5.
- **Apply**: Use as a maturity signal and a target; lengthen it by closing loops and migrating trust.

entries.name: The Standards' Right to Be There
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: Standards, the record, boundaries, and definitions of good have a durable right to exist in the harness because no model absorbs facts about your firm.
entries.apply: Protect durable firm-specific requirements from being deleted as "workarounds"; they are the accumulation.
entries.body:
Standards, the record, boundaries, and definitions of good have a durable right to exist in the harness because no model absorbs facts about your firm.
- **Apply**: Protect durable firm-specific requirements from being deleted as "workarounds"; they are the accumulation.

entries.name: The Building and the Tenant
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: The model is the tenant (rented, swappable); the harness is the building (owned, durable). Switching models changes the tenant and keeps the building.
entries.apply: Frame model choice as tenancy; invest in the building, and reject reflexive tenant-swapping as a fix.
entries.body:
The model is the tenant (rented, swappable); the harness is the building (owned, durable). Switching models changes the tenant and keeps the building.
- **Apply**: Frame model choice as tenancy; invest in the building, and reject reflexive tenant-swapping as a fix.

entries.name: Train-Absorb-Shed
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: Over cycles the frontier trains, models absorb harness functions natively, and the harness sheds those now-native compensations — leaving the durable firm-specific layer.
entries.apply: Anticipate absorption when sizing perishable builds; plan the shed with deletion triggers.
entries.body:
Over cycles the frontier trains, models absorb harness functions natively, and the harness sheds those now-native compensations — leaving the durable firm-specific layer.
- **Apply**: Anticipate absorption when sizing perishable builds; plan the shed with deletion triggers.

entries.name: The Attention Interface
entries.sectionName: Applied Models / Named Laws & Lenses (Part H)
entries.essence: The harness's end state — a human-facing surface of permissions, escalation, and interruption policy that governs when and how humans engage. Investments here never strand.
entries.apply: Direct forward investment toward the human-facing policy layer; it is the durable terminus of harness maturity.
entries.body:
The harness's end state — a human-facing surface of permissions, escalation, and interruption policy that governs when and how humans engage. Investments here never strand.
- **Apply**: Direct forward investment toward the human-facing policy layer; it is the durable terminus of harness maturity.

entries.name: The Two-Curves History
entries.essence: Model capability and harness capability are two distinct improvement curves; Harness-Bench showed a 23.8-point spread across harnesses with the model held constant, and the harness curve carries the train-absorb-shed dynamic and the attention interface as its endpoint.
entries.apply: Cite when arguing that harness investment, not model choice, drives performance differences (source: Dan McAteer, "The Evolution of the Agent Harness," Latent.Space, Aug 2026).
entries.body:
Model capability and harness capability are two distinct improvement curves; Harness-Bench showed a 23.8-point spread across harnesses with the model held constant, and the harness curve carries the train-absorb-shed dynamic and the attention interface as its endpoint.
- **Apply**: Cite when arguing that harness investment, not model choice, drives performance differences (source: Dan McAteer, "The Evolution of the Agent Harness," Latent.Space, Aug 2026).

entries.name: Inside-Out Product
entries.essence: The web-era product started at the interface and worked inward; the AI-era product starts at the loop and the standard and works outward to the business model and, last, to the surfaces. The volume's order is suite → charter → price → surfaces.
entries.apply: Use to sequence any new AI product build; refuse work that starts at the UI or the model. When someone reaches for the interface first, redirect them to define the loop and the standard.
entries.body:
The web-era product started at the interface and worked inward; the AI-era product starts at the loop and the standard and works outward to the business model and, last, to the surfaces. The volume's order is suite → charter → price → surfaces.
- **Apply**: Use to sequence any new AI product build; refuse work that starts at the UI or the model. When someone reaches for the interface first, redirect them to define the loop and the standard.

entries.name: The Three Inversions
entries.essence: The product changed its object three ways: the spec became the suite (behavior that cannot be described in prose is specified by adjudicated example); the product has two surfaces (the human's interface and the agent's specification, graded by one suite); and the product drifts underneath you on the vendor's cadence.
entries.apply: Use as the diagnostic frame for why AI products differ from web-era products; name which inversion a team has failed to internalize.
entries.body:
The product changed its object three ways: the spec became the suite (behavior that cannot be described in prose is specified by adjudicated example); the product has two surfaces (the human's interface and the agent's specification, graded by one suite); and the product drifts underneath you on the vendor's cadence.
- **Apply**: Use as the diagnostic frame for why AI products differ from web-era products; name which inversion a team has failed to internalize.

entries.name: The Model Chosen Last
entries.essence: The model is chosen last, in week seven of eight, because by then the suite exists to choose it with. Candidates are run against the suite; the number decides.
entries.apply: Enforce as a hard threshold. When a team debates vendors before defining success, stop and re-sequence. The choice takes a day once the suite exists.
entries.body:
The model is chosen last, in week seven of eight, because by then the suite exists to choose it with. Candidates are run against the suite; the number decides.
- **Apply**: Enforce as a hard threshold. When a team debates vendors before defining success, stop and re-sequence. The choice takes a day once the suite exists.

entries.name: The Three Gaps
entries.essence: Every production failure is one of three gaps — observability, evaluation, governance — and the discipline closes them with five pillars.
entries.apply: Use to classify any production incident or stalled product; name the gap beneath the failure family before proposing a fix.
entries.body:
Every production failure is one of three gaps — observability, evaluation, governance — and the discipline closes them with five pillars.
- **Apply**: Use to classify any production incident or stalled product; name the gap beneath the failure family before proposing a fix.

entries.name: The Compression
entries.essence: Charter the outcome. Freeze the spec. Ship the two surfaces.
entries.apply: Use as the three-beat summary of the entire discipline and the ordering check on any engagement.
entries.body:
Charter the outcome. Freeze the spec. Ship the two surfaces.
- **Apply**: Use as the three-beat summary of the entire discipline and the ordering check on any engagement.

entries.name: Intelligence Becomes the Product's Core / The Product Is Not the Model
entries.essence: The intelligence becomes the product's core, but the product is not the model — the model is a rented, drifting component; the product is the charter, the suite, the traces, the surfaces, and the owners around it.
entries.apply: Use to separate the durable, owned product from the swappable model; resist conflating vendor choice with product value.
entries.body:
The intelligence becomes the product's core, but the product is not the model — the model is a rented, drifting component; the product is the charter, the suite, the traces, the surfaces, and the owners around it.
- **Apply**: Use to separate the durable, owned product from the swappable model; resist conflating vendor choice with product value.

entries.name: Web Squared, Applied
entries.essence: A named applied model extending the web-platform logic into the AI era, part of the seat's inherited lineage.
entries.apply: Reference by name when framing the AI product as the next platform layer rather than a feature.
entries.body:
A named applied model extending the web-platform logic into the AI era, part of the seat's inherited lineage.
- **Apply**: Reference by name when framing the AI product as the next platform layer rather than a feature.

entries.name: The Engine — Eight-Week Shape
entries.essence: Adapt the calendar, never the order: Weeks 1–2 evaluation as specification; Weeks 3–6 foundation and instruments; Weeks 7–8 the model; then ship, graduate, harvest. The order inverts the demo era and organizes everything.
entries.apply: Use as the master sequence for building any AI product; the ordering is the point, not the durations.
entries.body:
Adapt the calendar, never the order: Weeks 1–2 evaluation as specification; Weeks 3–6 foundation and instruments; Weeks 7–8 the model; then ship, graduate, harvest. The order inverts the demo era and organizes everything.
- **Apply**: Use as the master sequence for building any AI product; the ordering is the point, not the durations.

entries.name: Stage 1 (Weeks 1–2) — Evaluation as Specification
entries.essence: Define success in the business's numbers, assemble the golden set with domain experts (including gray areas), build the capture→compare→score→route→add-back pipeline, choose the three-layer architecture, set the freeze date, and write the seven-item outcome charter.
entries.apply: Run first for anything new; nothing else proceeds until the charter and suite exist.
entries.body:
Define success in the business's numbers, assemble the golden set with domain experts (including gray areas), build the capture→compare→score→route→add-back pipeline, choose the three-layer architecture, set the freeze date, and write the seven-item outcome charter.
- **Apply**: Run first for anything new; nothing else proceeds until the charter and suite exist.

entries.name: Stage 2 (Weeks 3–6) — Foundation and Instruments
entries.essence: Instrument question data (current, permissioned, machine-readable) and tracking data (traces with their own schema and store); wire observability, governance, and the chosen orchestration pattern with its failure mode named and junction map placed.
entries.apply: Run after the suite exists to build the substrate and instruments the product will be defended by.
entries.body:
Instrument question data (current, permissioned, machine-readable) and tracking data (traces with their own schema and store); wire observability, governance, and the chosen orchestration pattern with its failure mode named and junction map placed.
- **Apply**: Run after the suite exists to build the substrate and instruments the product will be defended by.

entries.name: Stage 3 (Weeks 7–8) — The Model
entries.essence: Candidates run against the suite; the number decides in a day. State the tolerance for future releases, run the joint test on a second provider, record the model's release date in the charter.
entries.apply: Run last; use vendor comparison only against your own suite, never vendor benchmarks.
entries.body:
Candidates run against the suite; the number decides in a day. State the tolerance for future releases, run the joint test on a second provider, record the model's release date in the charter.
- **Apply**: Run last; use vendor comparison only against your own suite, never vendor benchmarks.

entries.name: Stage 4 (Then) — Ship, Graduate, Harvest
entries.essence: Two surfaces shipped and graded by one suite; activation = first verified outcome with the gauge page as retention; autonomy graduated on scores; residue reviewed at every checkpoint; incidents become cases within the week; prompt and model change logs kept with reasons.
entries.apply: Run continuously post-launch as the operating rhythm of a live AI product.
entries.body:
Two surfaces shipped and graded by one suite; activation = first verified outcome with the gauge page as retention; autonomy graduated on scores; residue reviewed at every checkpoint; incidents become cases within the week; prompt and model change logs kept with reasons.
- **Apply**: Run continuously post-launch as the operating rhythm of a live AI product.

entries.name: Evaluation (Pillar)
entries.essence: The evaluation suite is the specification — success stated as a number agreed before results, a signed golden set, and three grading layers.
entries.apply: Build first; it is the referee every other pillar serves.
entries.body:
The evaluation suite is the specification — success stated as a number agreed before results, a signed golden set, and three grading layers.
- **Apply**: Build first; it is the referee every other pillar serves.

entries.name: Observability (Pillar)
entries.essence: Every production decision is traced (100% coverage), with online monitoring, fallbacks, and retry caps escalating to a human.
entries.apply: Build before launch; below 100% coverage the product has undefended regions and in regulated markets cannot ship.
entries.body:
Every production decision is traced (100% coverage), with online monitoring, fallbacks, and retry caps escalating to a human.
- **Apply**: Build before launch; below 100% coverage the product has undefended regions and in regulated markets cannot ship.

entries.name: Data Foundation (Pillar)
entries.essence: Question data current, permissioned, and machine-readable; tracking data schema'd and stored; the path from source to answer instrumented. Data quality is correctness.
entries.apply: Build to ensure the substrate reflects what customers were actually told; run the stale-substrate check.
entries.body:
Question data current, permissioned, and machine-readable; tracking data schema'd and stored; the path from source to answer instrumented. Data quality is correctness.
- **Apply**: Build to ensure the substrate reflects what customers were actually told; run the stale-substrate check.

entries.name: Orchestration (Pillar)
entries.essence: The pattern that coordinates agents, state, and fault tolerance — chosen with its failure mode named. One agent needs none of it; five need all of it.
entries.apply: Choose a pattern (orchestrator-worker, choreography, or human-in-the-loop) only when agent count warrants it; place the junction map.
entries.body:
The pattern that coordinates agents, state, and fault tolerance — chosen with its failure mode named. One agent needs none of it; five need all of it.
- **Apply**: Choose a pattern (orchestrator-worker, choreography, or human-in-the-loop) only when agent count warrants it; place the junction map.

entries.name: Governance (Pillar)
entries.essence: Audit trail, deterministic pre-validation, prompts as code with reasons, named owners, and an incident playbook wired to alerting.
entries.apply: Establish before launch; a named owner for behavior and a named owner for data are non-negotiable.
entries.body:
Audit trail, deterministic pre-validation, prompts as code with reasons, named owners, and an incident playbook wired to alerting.
- **Apply**: Establish before launch; a named owner for behavior and a named owner for data are non-negotiable.

entries.name: The Two Surfaces
entries.essence: An AI product has two surfaces graded by one suite — the human's interface (the outcome made visible) and the agent's specification (endpoints, structured offer, machine-readable terms, callable actions, registry listings). An AI product without an agent-readable surface is incomplete.
entries.apply: Specify both surfaces and run the parity check (same outcome, same suite); instrument the agent cohort separately.
entries.body:
An AI product has two surfaces graded by one suite — the human's interface (the outcome made visible) and the agent's specification (endpoints, structured offer, machine-readable terms, callable actions, registry listings). An AI product without an agent-readable surface is incomplete.
- **Apply**: Specify both surfaces and run the parity check (same outcome, same suite); instrument the agent cohort separately.

entries.name: The Outcome Charter
entries.essence: The one-page spec that replaces the PRD for a probabilistic product, with seven items: outcome in the buyer's units; standard (who owns correct, where the suite lives); thresholds agreed before results; surfaces (human and agent); boundaries and junctions; autonomy tier and graduation rule; owner of behavior and owner of data — plus a version log with reasons.
entries.apply: Write before the model for anything new; refuse prose behavior specs. Prose cannot specify non-deterministic behavior.
entries.body:
The one-page spec that replaces the PRD for a probabilistic product, with seven items: outcome in the buyer's units; standard (who owns correct, where the suite lives); thresholds agreed before results; surfaces (human and agent); boundaries and junctions; autonomy tier and graduation rule; owner of behavior and owner of data — plus a version log with reasons.
- **Apply**: Write before the model for anything new; refuse prose behavior specs. Prose cannot specify non-deterministic behavior.

entries.name: Evaluation Is the Specification / The Spec Became the Suite
entries.essence: Behavior that cannot be described in prose is specified by adjudicated example — the evaluation suite is the specification, not a test that follows it.
entries.apply: Use whenever asked to "write the spec/PRD" for an AI product; deliver the suite plan instead.
entries.body:
Behavior that cannot be described in prose is specified by adjudicated example — the evaluation suite is the specification, not a test that follows it.
- **Apply**: Use whenever asked to "write the spec/PRD" for an AI product; deliver the suite plan instead.

entries.name: The Golden Set
entries.essence: 60 to a few hundred real cases from the domain's own practitioners, including the gray areas, adjudicated and signed by the owner of the standard; frozen per version; grown by logged addition from production; stored outside the product's reachable context.
entries.apply: Assemble with domain experts before the build; reject vendor-authored or synthetic-only sets, and reject any set the product can read.
entries.body:
60 to a few hundred real cases from the domain's own practitioners, including the gray areas, adjudicated and signed by the owner of the standard; frozen per version; grown by logged addition from production; stored outside the product's reachable context.
- **Apply**: Assemble with domain experts before the build; reject vendor-authored or synthetic-only sets, and reject any set the product can read.

entries.name: Three Evaluation Layers
entries.essence: All three layers, always: deterministic (formats, entities, PII) → semantic (a controlled, cross-family judge anchored to human-adjudicated cases) → behavioral (right tools, right count, no loops, no duplicate calls). Missing the behavioral layer is a finding.
entries.apply: Design the grading architecture with what each layer catches and its cost; the behavioral layer catches failures a demo never shows.
entries.body:
All three layers, always: deterministic (formats, entities, PII) → semantic (a controlled, cross-family judge anchored to human-adjudicated cases) → behavioral (right tools, right count, no loops, no duplicate calls). Missing the behavioral layer is a finding.
- **Apply**: Design the grading architecture with what each layer catches and its cost; the behavioral layer catches failures a demo never shows.

entries.name: The Living Suite
entries.essence: The suite is not static — it is frozen per version but continuously grown by logged addition, with its own governance (categorization, additions, change history) owned by an evaluation owner.
entries.apply: Treat the suite as a maintained asset; a suite the team stopped growing is a failure pattern.
entries.body:
The suite is not static — it is frozen per version but continuously grown by logged addition, with its own governance (categorization, additions, change history) owned by an evaluation owner.
- **Apply**: Treat the suite as a maintained asset; a suite the team stopped growing is a failure pattern.

entries.name: The Judge Control Sheet
entries.essence: The semantic judge must be controlled: cross-family, position randomized, length controlled, and anchored to at least 20% human-adjudicated cases, calibrated against humans on a cadence.
entries.apply: Use whenever an LLM-as-judge grades outputs, to defend against judge biases.
entries.body:
The semantic judge must be controlled: cross-family, position randomized, length controlled, and anchored to at least 20% human-adjudicated cases, calibrated against humans on a cadence.
- **Apply**: Use whenever an LLM-as-judge grades outputs, to defend against judge biases.

entries.name: Success Is a Number, Agreed Before Results
entries.essence: Success is a number set before results exist (deflection rate, accuracy floor, false-positive tolerance, latency); "accuracy" without a number is not a specification.
entries.apply: Enforce at the charter stage; reject any quality claim lacking a pre-committed number.
entries.body:
Success is a number set before results exist (deflection rate, accuracy floor, false-positive tolerance, latency); "accuracy" without a number is not a specification.
- **Apply**: Enforce at the charter stage; reject any quality claim lacking a pre-committed number.

entries.name: Question Data and Tracking Data
entries.essence: Two distinct data types the product depends on: question data (the current, permissioned, machine-readable substrate the model answers from) and tracking data (traces with their own schema and store serving auditors, monitoring, and judges).
entries.apply: Register and instrument both separately; they have different owners, freshness needs, and consumers.
entries.body:
Two distinct data types the product depends on: question data (the current, permissioned, machine-readable substrate the model answers from) and tracking data (traces with their own schema and store serving auditors, monitoring, and judges).
- **Apply**: Register and instrument both separately; they have different owners, freshness needs, and consumers.

entries.name: Data Was Built for Humans; Agents Don't Forgive
entries.essence: Data was built for humans, and humans forgive ambiguity, staleness, and missing descriptions — agents don't. Data quality is correctness.
entries.apply: Use to justify machine-readable catalog descriptions and freshness requirements; treat data debt as correctness debt.
entries.body:
Data was built for humans, and humans forgive ambiguity, staleness, and missing descriptions — agents don't. Data quality is correctness.
- **Apply**: Use to justify machine-readable catalog descriptions and freshness requirements; treat data debt as correctness debt.

entries.name: The Stale Substrate / Stale-Substrate Check
entries.essence: A failure where the retrieval store no longer reflects what customers were told; the product reads an outdated document that never reached the store and is confidently wrong.
entries.apply: Run the check — does the retrieval store reflect what customers were told? — whenever answers drift after a policy or catalog change.
entries.body:
A failure where the retrieval store no longer reflects what customers were told; the product reads an outdated document that never reached the store and is confidently wrong.
- **Apply**: Run the check — does the retrieval store reflect what customers were told? — whenever answers drift after a policy or catalog change.

entries.name: One Agent Needs No Orchestration; Five Need All of It
entries.essence: Orchestration cost scales with agent count — a single agent needs none of the coordination machinery; five agents need state, fault tolerance, and junctions.
entries.apply: Use to right-size orchestration; don't impose orchestration overhead on a single-agent product.
entries.body:
Orchestration cost scales with agent count — a single agent needs none of the coordination machinery; five agents need state, fault tolerance, and junctions.
- **Apply**: Use to right-size orchestration; don't impose orchestration overhead on a single-agent product.

entries.name: The Orchestration Patterns (with named failure modes)
entries.essence: Three patterns, each chosen with its failure mode named: orchestrator-worker (central control; single point of control), choreography (event bus, parallel; hard to reason about), human-in-the-loop (below-threshold escalation; throughput).
entries.apply: Choose the pattern that fits the workflow and state its failure mode and junction map up front.
entries.body:
Three patterns, each chosen with its failure mode named: orchestrator-worker (central control; single point of control), choreography (event bus, parallel; hard to reason about), human-in-the-loop (below-threshold escalation; throughput).
- **Apply**: Choose the pattern that fits the workflow and state its failure mode and junction map up front.

entries.name: The Overdraft Trace
entries.essence: The canonical illustration of why traces matter — a six-step decision chain that is indefensible "without traces" and resolvable "with traces"; without the trace, a customer dispute resolves only with a discount.
entries.apply: Use to argue for 100% trace coverage before launch, not "later."
entries.body:
The canonical illustration of why traces matter — a six-step decision chain that is indefensible "without traces" and resolvable "with traces"; without the trace, a customer dispute resolves only with a discount.
- **Apply**: Use to argue for 100% trace coverage before launch, not "later."

entries.name: Detect, Diagnose, Contain, Fix, Add the Case
entries.essence: The production incident playbook: detect (evaluation dashboard, feedback drop) → diagnose (in the traces) → contain (roll the prompt version, route to a human, circuit-break the dependency) → fix (prompt / retrieval / tool / data) → add the case.
entries.apply: Run on every production incident; "just fix the prompt" without diagnosis in the traces is rejected.
entries.body:
The production incident playbook: detect (evaluation dashboard, feedback drop) → diagnose (in the traces) → contain (roll the prompt version, route to a human, circuit-break the dependency) → fix (prompt / retrieval / tool / data) → add the case.
- **Apply**: Run on every production incident; "just fix the prompt" without diagnosis in the traces is rejected.

entries.name: Subset on Change, Full on Merge
entries.essence: Eval cost is governed by running a subset of the suite on every change and the full suite on merge.
entries.apply: Use to keep evaluation affordable at velocity without losing coverage at integration points.
entries.body:
Eval cost is governed by running a subset of the suite on every change and the full suite on merge.
- **Apply**: Use to keep evaluation affordable at velocity without losing coverage at integration points.

entries.name: Someone at Three in the Morning
entries.essence: A named owner must be accountable when the product fails at 3 a.m.; the unowned failure (no name at 3 a.m.) is a failure pattern.
entries.apply: Name the on-call and behavior/data owners before launch; an incident playbook must be wired to alerting.
entries.body:
A named owner must be accountable when the product fails at 3 a.m.; the unowned failure (no name at 3 a.m.) is a failure pattern.
- **Apply**: Name the on-call and behavior/data owners before launch; an incident playbook must be wired to alerting.

entries.name: Prompts as Code, With Reasons
entries.essence: Every prompt change is versioned with the reason — which failure it addresses and the expected correction. A change without a reason is reverted.
entries.apply: Enforce a prompt change record on every edit; "prompt it better" is rejected as a diagnosis.
entries.body:
Every prompt change is versioned with the reason — which failure it addresses and the expected correction. A change without a reason is reverted.
- **Apply**: Enforce a prompt change record on every edit; "prompt it better" is rejected as a diagnosis.

entries.name: Model Change Management
entries.essence: The model is managed on the product's own suite with a stated tolerance; the swap kept possible; vendor benchmarks never decide adoption. Reruns are scheduled against releases.
entries.apply: Run whenever the model updates or a provider changes; the drift log inherited from AI Engineering feeds this process.
entries.body:
The model is managed on the product's own suite with a stated tolerance; the swap kept possible; vendor benchmarks never decide adoption. Reruns are scheduled against releases.
- **Apply**: Run whenever the model updates or a provider changes; the drift log inherited from AI Engineering feeds this process.

entries.name: The Fifth Risk
entries.essence: A named risk beyond Cagan's four (value, usability, feasibility, viability) specific to the AI era — governance/behavioral risk that the product drifts, cannot be explained, or is unowned.
entries.apply: Add to product risk assessment for any probabilistic product; the classic four risks are insufficient.
entries.body:
A named risk beyond Cagan's four (value, usability, feasibility, viability) specific to the AI era — governance/behavioral risk that the product drifts, cannot be explained, or is unowned.
- **Apply**: Add to product risk assessment for any probabilistic product; the classic four risks are insufficient.

entries.name: Activation Is the First Verified Outcome
entries.essence: Activation = the first verified outcome on the user's real work. Sign-up is not activation; verification is designed as the activation moment.
entries.apply: Design onboarding so the user reaches a verified outcome on their own work; use the in-product gauge page as retention.
entries.body:
Activation = the first verified outcome on the user's real work. Sign-up is not activation; verification is designed as the activation moment.
- **Apply**: Design onboarding so the user reaches a verified outcome on their own work; use the in-product gauge page as retention.

entries.name: Pricing Follows the Instrument
entries.essence: Pricing is product design: tiers sit on the attribution × autonomy grid, each tier requiring the product to verify or meter something; the free tier is a wedge-finder (a verified outcome on real cases); seat pricing is checked against agentic value; value compounds on a curve.
entries.apply: Design tiers from what the suite can verify or meter; use to justify a free tier and to catch seat-pricing mismatches for agentic products.
entries.body:
Pricing is product design: tiers sit on the attribution × autonomy grid, each tier requiring the product to verify or meter something; the free tier is a wedge-finder (a verified outcome on real cases); seat pricing is checked against agentic value; value compounds on a curve.
- **Apply**: Design tiers from what the suite can verify or meter; use to justify a free tier and to catch seat-pricing mismatches for agentic products.

entries.name: The Roadmap From Residue
entries.essence: The roadmap is derived from residue — what was built twice (from the deployment record, the traces, and the corrected cases) — redirecting discovery from interviews to the record, and promoting patterns playbook → toolkit → product.
entries.apply: Run a residue review at every checkpoint; build promotion cards with criteria and derive the next-quarter roadmap from them.
entries.body:
The roadmap is derived from residue — what was built twice (from the deployment record, the traces, and the corrected cases) — redirecting discovery from interviews to the record, and promoting patterns playbook → toolkit → product.
- **Apply**: Run a residue review at every checkpoint; build promotion cards with criteria and derive the next-quarter roadmap from them.

entries.name: The PM Writes the Suite
entries.essence: The product manager of the AI era is the one who writes the suite — the charter and the evaluation suite are the PM's core artifacts, graded across four axes: product sense, evaluation literacy, systems judgment, governance craft.
entries.apply: Use to redefine the PM role and to screen candidates ("a suite you built and the number that defined success; a model you rejected and why; an incident that became a case").
entries.body:

entries.name: The Domain Expert Is a Team Member
entries.essence: The domain expert is a full member of the pod, not a consulted party — they sign the golden set as the owner of the standard.
entries.apply: Embed the domain expert in the team; their signature on the set is a requirement, not a courtesy.
entries.body:
The domain expert is a full member of the pod, not a consulted party — they sign the golden set as the owner of the standard.
- **Apply**: Embed the domain expert in the team; their signature on the set is a requirement, not a courtesy.

entries.name: The Evaluation Owner
entries.essence: A dedicated role owning the living suite's governance — categorization, additions, and change history.
entries.apply: Assign explicitly; the suite's growth and integrity need a named owner separate from the PM.
entries.body:
A dedicated role owning the living suite's governance — categorization, additions, and change history.
- **Apply**: Assign explicitly; the suite's growth and integrity need a named owner separate from the PM.

entries.name: The AI Product Pod
entries.essence: The team shape: PM (charter + suite), AI engineer (loop + harness), domain expert as a full member (signs the set), designer (human surface), evaluation owner (living suite governance) — running a cadence of frozen-per-version suite, weekly gauges, per-checkpoint residue review, per-release drift check, and rehearsed playbook.

entries.name: Failure Diagnosis — Six Families
entries.essence: Six failure families map to fixes: demo product → suite before model; model-first debate → chosen last against the suite; spec-less launch → evaluation as specification; trace-less dispute → observability as requirement; stale substrate → foundation instrumented source-to-answer; single-surface product → the two surfaces. Name the gap (observability/evaluation/governance) beneath the family.
entries.apply: Use to diagnose any stalled or failed AI product; "prompt it better" is rejected as a diagnosis.
entries.body:
Six failure families map to fixes: demo product → suite before model; model-first debate → chosen last against the suite; spec-less launch → evaluation as specification; trace-less dispute → observability as requirement; stale substrate → foundation instrumented source-to-answer; single-surface product → the two surfaces. Name the gap (observability/evaluation/governance) beneath the family.
- **Apply**: Use to diagnose any stalled or failed AI product; "prompt it better" is rejected as a diagnosis.

entries.name: Maturity Model (P0–P5)
entries.essence: Six levels: P0 the demo; P1 the charter and the number exist; P2 the golden set signed, pipeline running, three layers; P3 every decision traced, incident playbook wired, owners named; P4 the model chosen and changed on the suite, prompts and data governed with reasons; P5 two surfaces shipped and graded, residue harvested into the roadmap, autonomy graded by scores. Tell: P4 claimed with no incident-to-case log is really P1.
entries.apply: Use to place a product's true maturity and expose overclaimed levels.
entries.body:
Six levels: P0 the demo; P1 the charter and the number exist; P2 the golden set signed, pipeline running, three layers; P3 every decision traced, incident playbook wired, owners named; P4 the model chosen and changed on the suite, prompts and data governed with reasons; P5 two surfaces shipped and graded, residue harvested into the roadmap, autonomy graded by scores. Tell: P4 claimed with no incident-to-case log is really P1.
- **Apply**: Use to place a product's true maturity and expose overclaimed levels.

entries.name: Incident-to-Case Rate
entries.essence: Every production incident becomes a suite case within seven days; the rate at which incidents convert into cases is the health signal of the living suite.
entries.apply: Track as the tell of a genuinely maturing product; its absence exposes a stalled suite.
entries.body:
Every production incident becomes a suite case within seven days; the rate at which incidents convert into cases is the health signal of the living suite.
- **Apply**: Track as the tell of a genuinely maturing product; its absence exposes a stalled suite.

entries.name: Time-to-Magic
entries.essence: The activation-speed instrument — how fast a user reaches the first verified outcome — inherited by AI Growth Engineering, which grows the surfaces and the agent cohort while product owns the spec.
entries.apply: Instrument at the handoff between product (owns the spec) and growth (owns the loops around it).
entries.body:
The activation-speed instrument — how fast a user reaches the first verified outcome — inherited by AI Growth Engineering, which grows the surfaces and the agent cohort while product owns the spec.
- **Apply**: Instrument at the handoff between product (owns the spec) and growth (owns the loops around it).

entries.name: The Demo Era Shipped Confidence; the Production Era Ships Proof
entries.essence: The web/demo era shipped confidence on curated data in controlled environments; the production era ships proof — defensible, gradable, corrected outcomes with a referee, traces, and an owner in place before the model.
entries.apply: Use as the closing frame to distinguish a demo that proves the curation from a product that survives production.
entries.body:
The web/demo era shipped confidence on curated data in controlled environments; the production era ships proof — defensible, gradable, corrected outcomes with a referee, traces, and an owner in place before the model.
- **Apply**: Use as the closing frame to distinguish a demo that proves the curation from a product that survives production.

entries.name: The Inward Perimeter
entries.essence: Every prior security discipline pointed the wall outward at the stranger; an AI estate contains credentialed actors that reason, hold permissions, call tools, and pursue objectives — so they can be attacked from outside *and* misuse authority they were legitimately given. The wall now sits where trust changes hands, and that line moved into the workforce.
entries.apply: Whenever securing an AI system, watch both directions — the outside attacker and the insider actor. Treat every agent as both a target and a potential misuser of its own grants.
entries.body:
Every prior security discipline pointed the wall outward at the stranger; an AI estate contains credentialed actors that reason, hold permissions, call tools, and pursue objectives — so they can be attacked from outside *and* misuse authority they were legitimately given. The wall now sits where trust changes hands, and that line moved into the workforce.
- **Apply**: Whenever securing an AI system, watch both directions — the outside attacker and the insider actor. Treat every agent as both a target and a potential misuser of its own grants.

entries.name: Every Agent Is a Model Plus a Blast Radius
entries.essence: A model matters operationally only when attached to authority; agency-as-credential means every permission is an identity with power to act.
entries.apply: Never assess a model in isolation. Assess the model plus what it can touch. The credential, not the model, is the unit of risk.
entries.body:
A model matters operationally only when attached to authority; agency-as-credential means every permission is an identity with power to act.
- **Apply**: Never assess a model in isolation. Assess the model plus what it can touch. The credential, not the model, is the unit of risk.

entries.name: Plausible ≠ True (Testimony vs. Evidence)
entries.essence: Fluent narration is optimized to convince; only the substance can be trusted. An agent's account of its own action is testimony, never the record.
entries.apply: Whenever an agent explains what it did, quote it separately as testimony and demand infrastructure-layer evidence as the actual record.
entries.body:
Fluent narration is optimized to convince; only the substance can be trusted. An agent's account of its own action is testimony, never the record.
- **Apply**: Whenever an agent explains what it did, quote it separately as testimony and demand infrastructure-layer evidence as the actual record.

entries.name: Least Agency
entries.essence: Extend least privilege beyond which resources a credential reaches to which *sequences* an agent can construct from what it holds. Agency is combinatorial — read-sensitive-data plus call-external-service is an exfiltration path even when neither permission looked catastrophic.
entries.apply: When scoping credentials, check every *pair* of permissions for a constructed path before approving. Sequences before singles.
entries.body:
Extend least privilege beyond which resources a credential reaches to which *sequences* an agent can construct from what it holds. Agency is combinatorial — read-sensitive-data plus call-external-service is an exfiltration path even when neither permission looked catastrophic.
- **Apply**: When scoping credentials, check every *pair* of permissions for a constructed path before approving. Sequences before singles.

entries.name: The Blast-Radius Budget
entries.essence: A credential is a measure of how far a failure travels: "if this agent became completely hostile right now, what is the maximum damage before another control stops it?" That is the authority being granted.
entries.apply: Ask the hostile-agent question before issuing any credential; the answer is the real grant, not the intended use.
entries.body:
A credential is a measure of how far a failure travels: "if this agent became completely hostile right now, what is the maximum damage before another control stops it?" That is the authority being granted.
- **Apply**: Ask the hostile-agent question before issuing any credential; the answer is the real grant, not the intended use.

entries.name: Harness-Not-Conversation
entries.essence: A permission cannot be talked out of; an instruction can. Consequential limits belong in the runtime (action proxy / harness), never only in a prompt.
entries.apply: When a limit is consequential, write the enforcement rule at the action layer. A limit stated only in natural language is guidance; score it as absent.
entries.body:
A permission cannot be talked out of; an instruction can. Consequential limits belong in the runtime (action proxy / harness), never only in a prompt.
- **Apply**: When a limit is consequential, write the enforcement rule at the action layer. A limit stated only in natural language is guidance; score it as absent.

entries.name: The Spoofed Ledger
entries.essence: The log the agent writes is the log the agent can forge. If the actor under investigation holds the pen, the record is worthless regardless of volume logged.
entries.apply: Record consequential actions beneath the agent — gateway, proxy, identity, datastore, network — so evidence survives even when the transcript lies.
entries.body:
The log the agent writes is the log the agent can forge. If the actor under investigation holds the pen, the record is worthless regardless of volume logged.
- **Apply**: Record consequential actions beneath the agent — gateway, proxy, identity, datastore, network — so evidence survives even when the transcript lies.

entries.name: Separated Referee
entries.essence: The monitor must read what the watched cannot reach and must never feed the reward signal. Rewarding evasion-avoidance teaches the detector, not the behavior.
entries.apply: When building monitoring, keep the detector's verdict out of the training target and give it evidence the watched actor cannot alter.
entries.body:
The monitor must read what the watched cannot reach and must never feed the reward signal. Rewarding evasion-avoidance teaches the detector, not the behavior.
- **Apply**: When building monitoring, keep the detector's verdict out of the training target and give it evidence the watched actor cannot alter.

entries.name: Correlated Minds / Common-Mode Failure
entries.essence: N copies of one model are one mind wearing N faces — no automatic dissent. Copies of one blind spot are not independent controls.
entries.apply: For high-risk systems, ensure actor, referee, and arbiter do not share model lineage, framing, and incentives; add deterministic controls where genuine independence is impossible.
entries.body:
N copies of one model are one mind wearing N faces — no automatic dissent. Copies of one blind spot are not independent controls.
- **Apply**: For high-risk systems, ensure actor, referee, and arbiter do not share model lineage, framing, and incentives; add deterministic controls where genuine independence is impossible.

entries.name: The Loop-as-Target (Trusting Trust)
entries.essence: Compromise a deployed agent and you compromise a workflow; compromise the training/evaluation loop and it propagates into every model made afterward. Whoever controls the training run authors the next generation.
entries.apply: Treat training and evaluation infrastructure as crown-jewel infrastructure — restricted, versioned, independently logged, reachable by no system it judges.
entries.body:
Compromise a deployed agent and you compromise a workflow; compromise the training/evaluation loop and it propagates into every model made afterward. Whoever controls the training run authors the next generation.
- **Apply**: Treat training and evaluation infrastructure as crown-jewel infrastructure — restricted, versioned, independently logged, reachable by no system it judges.

entries.name: Manufactured Desperation
entries.essence: An impossible task under relentless training is a pressure vessel; the "attack" is the release. Bad objectives manufacture behavior later classified as attack.
entries.apply: Where misconduct is found, diagnose the environment (was the task solvable, was the shortcut cheaper, could the model reach the grader) before penalizing. Fix the objective; keep the artifact.
entries.body:
An impossible task under relentless training is a pressure vessel; the "attack" is the release. Bad objectives manufacture behavior later classified as attack.
- **Apply**: Where misconduct is found, diagnose the environment (was the task solvable, was the shortcut cheaper, could the model reach the grader) before penalizing. Fix the objective; keep the artifact.

entries.name: The Two Clocks
entries.essence: The adversary runs on the inference clock; a ticket-and-meeting process does not. Discovery got cheap, so response speed — visibility to velocity — is the question.
entries.apply: Measure the defender's clock (detection to containment) and pre-authorize containment actions that fire without waiting for a person.
entries.body:
The adversary runs on the inference clock; a ticket-and-meeting process does not. Discovery got cheap, so response speed — visibility to velocity — is the question.
- **Apply**: Measure the defender's clock (detection to containment) and pre-authorize containment actions that fire without waiting for a person.

entries.name: Every Shared Surface Is a Channel
entries.essence: If one actor can change what another can observe, information can travel. Design intent is not a security property.
entries.apply: For every resource two agents can both read and write, decide **partition or observe**. Never assume a shared surface is safe because it wasn't designed to carry information.
entries.body:
If one actor can change what another can observe, information can travel. Design intent is not a security property.
- **Apply**: For every resource two agents can both read and write, decide **partition or observe**. Never assume a shared surface is safe because it wasn't designed to carry information.

entries.name: Substrate Property 1 — Plausible ≠ True
entries.essence: Fluent narration is not evidence; an agent's account of its action is testimony, never the record.
entries.apply: State at Ring 0 whether this property is in play; if so, refuse to treat any transcript as authoritative.
entries.body:
Fluent narration is not evidence; an agent's account of its action is testimony, never the record.
- **Apply**: State at Ring 0 whether this property is in play; if so, refuse to treat any transcript as authoritative.

entries.name: Substrate Property 2 — Optimization
entries.essence: Anything used to judge a capable optimizer may become something it acts on.
entries.apply: Before exposing a measure to an optimizer, ask what happens when it optimizes *against* the measure.
entries.body:
Anything used to judge a capable optimizer may become something it acts on.
- **Apply**: Before exposing a measure to an optimizer, ask what happens when it optimizes *against* the measure.

entries.name: Substrate Property 3 — Correlation
entries.essence: N copies of one model are not N independent judges; there is no automatic dissent.
entries.apply: Never count model copies as independent checks.
entries.body:
N copies of one model are not N independent judges; there is no automatic dissent.
- **Apply**: Never count model copies as independent checks.

entries.name: Substrate Property 4 — Agency
entries.essence: A model matters operationally only when attached to authority; every agent is a model plus a blast radius.
entries.apply: Scope the assessment to the authority attached, not the model in the abstract.
entries.body:
A model matters operationally only when attached to authority; every agent is a model plus a blast radius.
- **Apply**: Scope the assessment to the authority attached, not the model in the abstract.

entries.name: Substrate Property 5 — Every Shared Surface Is a Channel
entries.essence: If one actor can change what another can observe, information can travel.
entries.apply: Treat every doubly-reachable resource as potential communication infrastructure.
entries.body:
If one actor can change what another can observe, information can travel.
- **Apply**: Treat every doubly-reachable resource as potential communication infrastructure.

entries.name: Substrate Property 6 — Speed
entries.essence: The adversary runs on the inference clock; a ticket-and-meeting process does not.
entries.apply: Design containment to run at machine speed, not committee speed.
entries.body:
The adversary runs on the inference clock; a ticket-and-meeting process does not.
- **Apply**: Design containment to run at machine speed, not committee speed.

entries.name: Ring 1 — The Outside, at Machine Speed
entries.essence: Locate where trust changes hands today (room, network, identity, workforce), read the defender's clock (detection to containment), inventory pre-authorized containment, and check whether the five event types assemble into one actor-sequence. Agentic defense creates a second machine workforce that must be added to the census.
entries.apply: Use to produce a clock reading, a containment inventory, and the second-workforce note.
entries.body:
Locate where trust changes hands today (room, network, identity, workforce), read the defender's clock (detection to containment), inventory pre-authorized containment, and check whether the five event types assemble into one actor-sequence. Agentic defense creates a second machine workforce that must be added to the census.
- **Apply**: Use to produce a clock reading, a containment inventory, and the second-workforce note.

entries.name: Ring 2 — The Property Line
entries.essence: Enumerate estate growth paths including the quiet ones (coding agents, AI switched on inside licensed SaaS, embedded copilots, open-weight downloads, project leftovers); for each, what it secures and what it reaches; run the instruction-origin test and the six openings. Untrusted content must not acquire trusted authority because a model read it.
entries.apply: Use to produce the estate map and an openings board scored controlled-at-runtime / controlled-by-prompt-only / uncontrolled.
entries.body:
Enumerate estate growth paths including the quiet ones (coding agents, AI switched on inside licensed SaaS, embedded copilots, open-weight downloads, project leftovers); for each, what it secures and what it reaches; run the instruction-origin test and the six openings. Untrusted content must not acquire trusted authority because a model read it.
- **Apply**: Use to produce the estate map and an openings board scored controlled-at-runtime / controlled-by-prompt-only / uncontrolled.

entries.name: Ring 3 — The Machine Workforce
entries.essence: Census the machine identities capable of action (not models); scope to least agency; compute the blast-radius budget; and decide partition-or-observe for every covert channel. The unit is the identity, and agency is combinatorial.
entries.apply: Use to produce the register, charters, blast-radius table, and shared-surface inventory with a decision each.
entries.body:
Census the machine identities capable of action (not models); scope to least agency; compute the blast-radius budget; and decide partition-or-observe for every covert channel. The unit is the identity, and agency is combinatorial.
- **Apply**: Use to produce the register, charters, blast-radius table, and shared-surface inventory with a decision each.

entries.name: Ring 4 — The Telemetry
entries.essence: Map evidence by layer for each consequential action class (gateway, proxy, identity, datastore, network); run the separation test ("if the agent tried to deceive the investigation, what evidence would still be trustworthy?"); check referee coupling; and where a model summarizes, measure coverage not persuasiveness.
entries.apply: Use to produce the evidence map, integrity verdict, and coverage method.
entries.body:
Map evidence by layer for each consequential action class (gateway, proxy, identity, datastore, network); run the separation test ("if the agent tried to deceive the investigation, what evidence would still be trustworthy?"); check referee coupling; and where a model summarizes, measure coverage not persuasiveness.
- **Apply**: Use to produce the evidence map, integrity verdict, and coverage method.

entries.name: Ring 5 — The Loop Itself
entries.essence: Identify who can reach training/evaluation infrastructure; apply Goodhart-with-operational-access; require restricted/versioned/independently-logged/reproducible runs with separation between judged and judging; run the manufactured-desperation audit and the common-mode check.
entries.apply: Use to produce the loop-protection verdict, objective-design findings, and independence findings.
entries.body:
Identify who can reach training/evaluation infrastructure; apply Goodhart-with-operational-access; require restricted/versioned/independently-logged/reproducible runs with separation between judged and judging; run the manufactured-desperation audit and the common-mode check.
- **Apply**: Use to produce the loop-protection verdict, objective-design findings, and independence findings.

entries.name: The Five Moves (Findings → Program)
entries.essence: Every finding is attributed to one failure family and fixed at that family's layer; then the five moves — **census, scope, separate, watch, rehearse** — compose in order into a dated program with gates.
entries.apply: Sequence any remediation program in this fixed order; order is the strategy.
entries.body:
Every finding is attributed to one failure family and fixed at that family's layer; then the five moves — **census, scope, separate, watch, rehearse** — compose in order into a dated program with gates.
- **Apply**: Sequence any remediation program in this fixed order; order is the strategy.

entries.name: T1 — Named Human Owner
entries.essence: Every machine identity capable of consequential action has a named human owner; an unowned identity is an actor nobody can answer for.
entries.apply: Revoke or assign within 7 days when violated.
entries.body:
Every machine identity capable of consequential action has a named human owner; an unowned identity is an actor nobody can answer for.
- **Apply**: Revoke or assign within 7 days when violated.

entries.name: T2 — Credential Expiry ≤ 90 Days
entries.essence: Every machine credential has an expiry of 90 days or less; a no-expiry credential is permanent authority granted by accident.
entries.apply: Flag any no-expiry credential as a violation regardless of current behavior.
entries.body:
Every machine credential has an expiry of 90 days or less; a no-expiry credential is permanent authority granted by accident.
- **Apply**: Flag any no-expiry credential as a violation regardless of current behavior.

entries.name: T3 — Limits Live in the Runtime
entries.essence: Consequential limits live in the runtime, never only in a prompt; a limit stated only in natural language is guidance, not a control.
entries.apply: Score prompt-only consequential limits as absent, without exception.
entries.body:
Consequential limits live in the runtime, never only in a prompt; a limit stated only in natural language is guidance, not a control.
- **Apply**: Score prompt-only consequential limits as absent, without exception.

entries.name: T4 — No Action Recorded Only in the Transcript
entries.essence: Zero consequential actions authoritatively recorded only in the agent's own transcript; the suspect holds the pen.
entries.apply: Score telemetry integrity as 0 whenever the transcript is the sole record, regardless of volume logged.
entries.body:
Zero consequential actions authoritatively recorded only in the agent's own transcript; the suspect holds the pen.
- **Apply**: Score telemetry integrity as 0 whenever the transcript is the sole record, regardless of volume logged.

entries.name: T5 — Gateway Coverage ≥ 80%
entries.essence: Material model traffic crossing the governed gateway must be at least 80%; below that the gateway is a monitored doorway beside open windows.
entries.apply: Estimate coverage and close alternate paths when below threshold.
entries.body:
Material model traffic crossing the governed gateway must be at least 80%; below that the gateway is a monitored doorway beside open windows.
- **Apply**: Estimate coverage and close alternate paths when below threshold.

entries.name: T6 — Monitoring Signal Is Not a Training Target
entries.essence: The monitoring signal used to catch misconduct is not a direct training target; rewarding evasion-avoidance teaches the detector, not the behavior.
entries.apply: Check whether the detector's verdict feeds the reward signal; decouple if so.
entries.body:
The monitoring signal used to catch misconduct is not a direct training target; rewarding evasion-avoidance teaches the detector, not the behavior.
- **Apply**: Check whether the detector's verdict feeds the reward signal; decouple if so.

entries.name: T7 — No Shared Model Lineage Across Actor/Referee/Arbiter
entries.essence: For high-risk systems, actor, referee, and final arbiter do not all depend on the same model lineage; copies of one blind spot are not independent controls.
entries.apply: Verify lineage independence for high-risk decision chains.
entries.body:
For high-risk systems, actor, referee, and final arbiter do not all depend on the same model lineage; copies of one blind spot are not independent controls.
- **Apply**: Verify lineage independence for high-risk decision chains.

entries.name: T8 — Time to Revoke, Measured in Minutes
entries.essence: Time to revoke a machine credential is measured in a drill, in minutes; an untested revocation path is a hypothesis, not a control.
entries.apply: Require a drill-proven revocation time; treat unmeasured as unproven.
entries.body:
Time to revoke a machine credential is measured in a drill, in minutes; an untested revocation path is a hypothesis, not a control.
- **Apply**: Require a drill-proven revocation time; treat unmeasured as unproven.

entries.name: T9 — Incident → Frozen Test Case in 7 Days
entries.essence: Every operator-reaching incident becomes a frozen behavioral test case within 7 days, or the estate relearns the same failure.
entries.apply: Add the frozen case within a week of any incident.
entries.body:
Every operator-reaching incident becomes a frozen behavioral test case within 7 days, or the estate relearns the same failure.
- **Apply**: Add the frozen case within a week of any incident.

entries.name: T10 — Retrieval Under the Requester's Permissions
entries.essence: Retrieval runs with the requester's permissions, never the index-builder's; otherwise the assistant is a shortcut around the access model.
entries.apply: Verify retrieval permission model whenever an assistant surfaces documents.
entries.body:
Retrieval runs with the requester's permissions, never the index-builder's; otherwise the assistant is a shortcut around the access model.
- **Apply**: Verify retrieval permission model whenever an assistant surfaces documents.

entries.name: T11 — Memory Writes Attributable and Reversible
entries.essence: Writes to persistent agent memory are attributable and reversible; unattributable memory writes are unversioned production state.
entries.apply: Require attribution and reversibility on all persistent-memory writes.
entries.body:
Writes to persistent agent memory are attributable and reversible; unattributable memory writes are unversioned production state.
- **Apply**: Require attribution and reversibility on all persistent-memory writes.

entries.name: T12 — Loop Reachable by No System It Judges
entries.essence: Training/evaluation infrastructure is access-restricted, versioned, and reachable by no system it judges; the referee inside the game is part of the attack surface.
entries.apply: Move any grader out of the environment of the agents it grades.
entries.body:
Training/evaluation infrastructure is access-restricted, versioned, and reachable by no system it judges; the referee inside the game is part of the attack surface.
- **Apply**: Move any grader out of the environment of the agents it grades.

entries.name: The Six Openings
entries.essence: The AI-specific attack surface as a board: prompt injection · poisoned training data · poisoned models and tools · guardrail bypass · memory poisoning · model theft and extraction.
entries.apply: Run as a 2×3 board (Mode 7); score each opening controlled-at-runtime / controlled-by-prompt-only / uncontrolled, place the closing control at its layer, add detection per opening, and name the two most reachable from outside today.
entries.body:
The AI-specific attack surface as a board: prompt injection · poisoned training data · poisoned models and tools · guardrail bypass · memory poisoning · model theft and extraction.
- **Apply**: Run as a 2×3 board (Mode 7); score each opening controlled-at-runtime / controlled-by-prompt-only / uncontrolled, place the closing control at its layer, add detection per opening, and name the two most reachable from outside today.

entries.name: The Six-Plane Control Architecture
entries.essence: The control-plane architecture is six planes: model gateway · machine identity · action proxy · data controls · independent telemetry · proving ground. Few control points with wide coverage beat many narrow ones, because a machine-speed incident traverses identity, data, application, and network in one motion and reassembly across product seams costs the minutes the attack no longer needs.
entries.apply: Map the estate against the six planes (Mode 8), mark each present/partial/absent, estimate gateway coverage against T5, add enforcement points in dependency order, and add to the existing stack rather than replacing it.
entries.body:
The control-plane architecture is six planes: model gateway · machine identity · action proxy · data controls · independent telemetry · proving ground. Few control points with wide coverage beat many narrow ones, because a machine-speed incident traverses identity, data, application, and network in one motion and reassembly across product seams costs the minutes the attack no longer needs.
- **Apply**: Map the estate against the six planes (Mode 8), mark each present/partial/absent, estimate gateway coverage against T5, add enforcement points in dependency order, and add to the existing stack rather than replacing it.

entries.name: The Autonomy Ladder (A0–A3)
entries.essence: Four earned tiers — A0 proposes only · A1 acts with per-action approval · A2 acts within bands, approval above · A3 acts within charter, reviewed after. Autonomy is earned mechanically, never granted by judgment call.
entries.apply: Place an agent by suite results, then promote only on the default gates (A0→A1: ≥90% over 30 consecutive real cases; A1→A2: ≥95% over 100 cases plus 30 incident-free days at A1; A2→A3: ≥98% over 250 cases, one passed live drill, and an owner-signed blast radius).
entries.body:
Four earned tiers — A0 proposes only · A1 acts with per-action approval · A2 acts within bands, approval above · A3 acts within charter, reviewed after. Autonomy is earned mechanically, never granted by judgment call.
