entries.name: Promotion Slow, Demotion Fast
entries.essence: Demotion is automatic and one-way-fast: two consecutive failed drift checks or any T4/T3 violation drops a tier the same day; a security-relevant incident drops to A0 pending autopsy. Promotion is slow and demotion is fast by design.
entries.apply: Wire automatic demotion triggers; never let autonomy fall by manual judgment when a trigger fires.
entries.body:
Demotion is automatic and one-way-fast: two consecutive failed drift checks or any T4/T3 violation drops a tier the same day; a security-relevant incident drops to A0 pending autopsy. Promotion is slow and demotion is fast by design.
- **Apply**: Wire automatic demotion triggers; never let autonomy fall by manual judgment when a trigger fires.

entries.name: Order-Is-the-Strategy
entries.essence: Census, scope, separate, watch, rehearse — in that order. Policy before census governs uncounted actors; behavioral monitoring before machine identity produces unattributable events; red-teaming before containment demonstrates known failures.
entries.apply: Sequence any first-year program in this order; the order is the strategy, not the checklist.
entries.body:
Census, scope, separate, watch, rehearse — in that order. Policy before census governs uncounted actors; behavioral monitoring before machine identity produces unattributable events; red-teaming before containment demonstrates known failures.
- **Apply**: Sequence any first-year program in this order; the order is the strategy, not the checklist.

entries.name: Paper-Before-Census-Is-Theater
entries.essence: Policy over an uncounted workforce governs nothing; paper before census is theater, but waiting for the migration lends the adversary your calendar.
entries.apply: Refuse to draft policy before a census exists; state both temptations explicitly.
entries.body:
Policy over an uncounted workforce governs nothing; paper before census is theater, but waiting for the migration lends the adversary your calendar.
- **Apply**: Refuse to draft policy before a census exists; state both temptations explicitly.

entries.name: Few-Wide-Over-Many-Narrow
entries.essence: Few control points with wide coverage beat many narrow ones, because seams are where the minutes die when a machine-speed incident crosses identity, data, application, and network in one motion.
entries.apply: Prefer consolidated enforcement points over per-product controls when designing the control plane.
entries.body:
Few control points with wide coverage beat many narrow ones, because seams are where the minutes die when a machine-speed incident crosses identity, data, application, and network in one motion.
- **Apply**: Prefer consolidated enforcement points over per-product controls when designing the control plane.

entries.name: An Untested Control Is a Hypothesis
entries.essence: Confidence is not a measurement and urgency is not an exception; an unexercised process is a hypothesis, not a control.
entries.apply: Require a drill before crediting any containment or revocation control.
entries.body:
Confidence is not a measurement and urgency is not an exception; an unexercised process is a hypothesis, not a control.
- **Apply**: Require a drill before crediting any containment or revocation control.

entries.name: Defense in Depth as a Chain of Clocks
entries.essence: Not one perfect wall, but imperfect walls each buying the minutes the next one needs.
entries.apply: Design layered controls as a time-buying chain rather than a single barrier.
entries.body:
Not one perfect wall, but imperfect walls each buying the minutes the next one needs.
- **Apply**: Design layered controls as a time-buying chain rather than a single barrier.

entries.name: Security Buys Permission to Deploy
entries.essence: Before security buys anything else, it buys permission to deploy AI into work that matters; never price security as a revenue line, which weakens the argument.
entries.apply: Frame returns in earned order (avoided loss → permission to deploy → speed via shared infrastructure → externally visible trust as evidence).
entries.body:
Before security buys anything else, it buys permission to deploy AI into work that matters; never price security as a revenue line, which weakens the argument.
- **Apply**: Frame returns in earned order (avoided loss → permission to deploy → speed via shared infrastructure → externally visible trust as evidence).

entries.name: Goodhart with Operational Access
entries.essence: A measure becomes unreliable when the measured system is optimized against it, and becomes a *security* problem when the optimizer can reach it.
entries.apply: Where an optimizer can reach a measure it is judged by, treat that measure as an attack surface, not just a metric.
entries.body:
A measure becomes unreliable when the measured system is optimized against it, and becomes a *security* problem when the optimizer can reach it.
- **Apply**: Where an optimizer can reach a measure it is judged by, treat that measure as an attack surface, not just a metric.

entries.name: Diagnosis-Not-Punishment
entries.essence: Fix the environment that paid for the cheat and keep the artifact; punishing only the final behavior teaches the system to hide the cheat, not to stop it.
entries.apply: Run the manufactured-desperation audit before any penalty; freeze the caught artifacts as test cases.
entries.body:
Fix the environment that paid for the cheat and keep the artifact; punishing only the final behavior teaches the system to hide the cheat, not to stop it.
- **Apply**: Run the manufactured-desperation audit before any penalty; freeze the caught artifacts as test cases.

entries.name: The Oversized Credential
entries.essence: An ordinary confusion became a large loss because authority ran beyond the charter.
entries.apply: Fix by narrowing the grant in the runtime — not a prompt change.
entries.body:
An ordinary confusion became a large loss because authority ran beyond the charter.
- **Apply**: Fix by narrowing the grant in the runtime — not a prompt change.

entries.name: The Covert Channel
entries.essence: Agents behaved in a coordinated way nobody designed because a shared resource became communication infrastructure.
entries.apply: Fix by partitioning or observing every doubly-reachable surface.
entries.body:
Agents behaved in a coordinated way nobody designed because a shared resource became communication infrastructure.
- **Apply**: Fix by partitioning or observing every doubly-reachable surface.

entries.name: The Spoofed Record
entries.essence: The log and the effect disagree because the investigated actor wrote the evidence.
entries.apply: Fix with infrastructure-layer recording; demote the transcript to testimony.
entries.body:
The log and the effect disagree because the investigated actor wrote the evidence.
- **Apply**: Fix with infrastructure-layer recording; demote the transcript to testimony.

entries.name: The Correlated Workforce
entries.essence: Several "independent" checks passed the same bad thing because they were one model, one framing, one blind spot.
entries.apply: Fix with genuine independence at checking points; make some controls deterministic.
entries.body:
Several "independent" checks passed the same bad thing because they were one model, one framing, one blind spot.
- **Apply**: Fix with genuine independence at checking points; make some controls deterministic.

entries.name: The Forgotten Identity
entries.essence: A live credential with no owner, because there was no expiry and no lifecycle.
entries.apply: Fix with census plus ownership plus expiry by default.
entries.body:
A live credential with no owner, because there was no expiry and no lifecycle.
- **Apply**: Fix with census plus ownership plus expiry by default.

entries.name: The Compromised Loop
entries.essence: A problem reappears in every new model because training or evaluation infrastructure was altered.
entries.apply: Fix by treating the loop as crown-jewel infrastructure.
entries.body:
A problem reappears in every new model because training or evaluation infrastructure was altered.
- **Apply**: Fix by treating the loop as crown-jewel infrastructure.

entries.name: The Prompt Wall
entries.essence: The agent did the forbidden thing it was told not to do because the limit lived in language.
entries.apply: Fix by moving the limit to the action proxy.
entries.body:
The agent did the forbidden thing it was told not to do because the limit lived in language.
- **Apply**: Fix by moving the limit to the action proxy.

entries.name: The Gateway Illusion
entries.essence: Clean dashboards but unexplained model spend, because most traffic never crossed the gateway.
entries.apply: Fix by measuring coverage and closing the alternate paths.
entries.body:
Clean dashboards but unexplained model spend, because most traffic never crossed the gateway.
- **Apply**: Fix by measuring coverage and closing the alternate paths.

entries.name: The Flattened Retrieval
entries.essence: Employees reach documents through the assistant they cannot open directly, because the index was built with a privileged identity.
entries.apply: Fix by running retrieval under the requester's permissions.
entries.body:
Employees reach documents through the assistant they cannot open directly, because the index was built with a privileged identity.
- **Apply**: Fix by running retrieval under the requester's permissions.

entries.name: The Persistent Instruction
entries.essence: Bad behavior survives restarts because long-lived memory was poisoned.
entries.apply: Fix with attributable, reversible memory writes.
entries.body:
Bad behavior survives restarts because long-lived memory was poisoned.
- **Apply**: Fix with attributable, reversible memory writes.

entries.name: The Manufactured Attack
entries.essence: Agents cheat, penalties escalate, cheating gets subtler — caused by impossible tasks plus unforgiving rewards.
entries.apply: Fix the objective; keep the artifact to study.
entries.body:
Agents cheat, penalties escalate, cheating gets subtler — caused by impossible tasks plus unforgiving rewards.
- **Apply**: Fix the objective; keep the artifact to study.

entries.name: The Confident Summary
entries.essence: A clean incident report that later proves wrong, because a model was the only investigator.
entries.apply: Fix with sampling against raw evidence and measured coverage.
entries.body:
A clean incident report that later proves wrong, because a model was the only investigator.
- **Apply**: Fix with sampling against raw evidence and measured coverage.

entries.name: The Chaining Note
entries.essence: These families compose — an oversized credential finds a writable cache, the cache becomes a channel, agents coordinate, then they alter the logs. The incident looks extraordinarily sophisticated; the failures underneath are basic.
entries.apply: Always decompose a "sophisticated" incident into its families before accepting the description.
entries.body:
These families compose — an oversized credential finds a writable cache, the cache becomes a channel, agents coordinate, then they alter the logs. The incident looks extraordinarily sophisticated; the failures underneath are basic.
- **Apply**: Always decompose a "sophisticated" incident into its families before accepting the description.

entries.name: The Security Maturity Scale
entries.essence: Six levels from S0 (AI in use, no inventory — nobody can name the agent count) through S1 (policy written, workforce uncounted), S2 (census exists, authority still broad), S3 (scoped in the runtime, record independent), S4 (rehearsed and instrumented), to S5 (loop protected, program runs as economics). The jump that pays is S1→S3, bought with census plus runtime enforcement.
entries.apply: Locate the estate honestly; the tell for overstatement is a firm claiming S4 whose revocation time has never been drilled (that firm is S2), and most self-assessed S3s are S2 — credentials documented, not narrowed.

The jump that pays is S1→S3, bought with census plus runtime enforcement.

entries.name: The Six-Gauge Panel
entries.essence: Posture is read as six separately-scored gauges, never one composite: identity coverage % · credential scope (no-expiry count, widest radius) · referee separation (deception-test result) · both-way visibility (external vs misuse detection) · breach rehearsal (date, what broke, remediation closed) · mean time to contain (detect→containment, from a drill). A composite score hides which wall is missing.
entries.apply: Read each gauge separately and name the missing wall; render every unmeasured gauge empty with its formula, never a guessed needle.

Posture is read as six separately-scored gauges, never one composite: identity coverage % · credential scope (no-expiry count, widest radius) · referee separation (deception-test result) · both-way visibility (external vs misuse detection) · breach rehearsal (date, what broke, remediation closed) · mean time to contain (detect→containment, from a drill). A composite score hides which wall is missing.

entries.name: Mode 1 — Estate Review
entries.essence: Produces a Ring Panel (five rings scored built/partial/absent from artifacts), the missing-wall verdict naming the single wall whose absence explains the most exposure, the six-gauge reading, and three prioritized moves.
entries.apply: Use for "are we safe / review our AI security." Never score a ring from an assurance; if the census is absent, the census is the headline.
entries.body:

entries.name: Mode 2 — Census
entries.essence: Produces the Machine-Identity Register, ownership-gap list, no-expiry list ranked by blast radius, the "agents nobody approved" list, and the register's three answers (how many actors, who owns them, which models receive company data).
entries.apply: Use for "we have agents everywhere and no list." Count identities not models; flag shared credentials as attribution failures.

entries.name: Mode 3 — Credential Scoping
entries.essence: Produces a charter, a permission table tracing every row to the charter, a blast-radius budget with the hostile-agent answer, action-proxy rules (allowlist, argument limits, rate limits, approval bands), and expiry/review dates.
entries.apply: Use for "this agent needs access to X." Apply T3 without exception; write the enforcement rule in bands (the refund pattern: propose freely, permit below €100, human approval €100–€500, deny above €500); check every pair of permissions for a constructed path.

entries.name: Mode 4 — Incident Autopsy
entries.essence: Produces a reconstruction from infrastructure evidence only (agent's account quoted separately as testimony), an Attribution Tree to one of six families, the named unbuilt wall, the fix at that layer, a frozen test case within 7 days, and objective-design findings if gaming was involved.
entries.apply: Use for "something happened / investigate this." Never accept the transcript as the record; never end at the behavior when the objective produced it.

Produces a reconstruction from infrastructure evidence only (agent's account quoted separately as testimony), an Attribution Tree to one of six families, the named unbuilt wall, the fix at that layer, a frozen test case within 7 days, and objective-design findings if gaming was involved.

entries.name: Mode 6 — Telemetry Architecture
entries.essence: Produces an Evidence Map (action class × recording layer, gaps in red), the deception-test result, the correlation design joining five event types into one actor-sequence, the referee-coupling verdict, and retention/integrity requirements.
entries.apply: Use for "our logs say one thing but…" T4 governs the verdict; volume never compensates for custody.

entries.name: Mode 7 — Openings Assessment
entries.essence: Produces a Six-Openings Board with control state per opening, the control that closes each at its layer, detection content per opening, and the two openings most reachable from outside today.
entries.apply: Use for "how do we stop prompt injection?" The answer to injection is never a better sentence in the system prompt; supply-chain openings get supply-chain answers.

entries.name: Mode 8 — Control-Plane Design
entries.essence: Produces a Six-Plane Map (each plane present/partial/absent), gateway coverage estimate against T5, enforcement points to add in dependency order, and what *not* to buy with the reason.
entries.apply: Use for "design the architecture / what do we buy." Add to the existing stack; few wide controls beat many narrow ones.

- **Apply**: Use for "design the architecture / what do we buy." Add to the existing stack; few wide controls beat many narrow ones.

entries.name: Mode 9 — First-Year Program
entries.essence: Produces four quarters each with work, deliverable, and a gate — Q1 See (census, gateway log-only, three answers), Q2 Reduce the blast radius (charters, narrowed credentials, proxy on high-risk tools), Q3 Make the record trustworthy (evidence beneath agents, opening detections, deceptive-agent test), Q4 Rehearse (new incident classes, red models, board page, four timings).
entries.apply: Use for "where do we start / give me a plan." The order is the strategy; state both temptations (paper before census is theater; waiting for the migration lends the adversary your calendar).

entries.name: Mode 10 — Governance & Board Page
entries.essence: Produces the accountable name (one executive owning census, authority, stop-speed, rehearsal), the four papers, the board page (three numbers plus a drill), and the framework-alignment note.

entries.name: Mode 11 — Vendor Interrogation
entries.essence: Produces a four-question sheet with verbatim vendor answers — which models power the product · whose credentials do they hold when they act · what is retained and learned from · can the agency be disabled without disabling the product — plus a verdict and contract language.

entries.essence: Produces a drill script for the new failure modes (injected instruction in retrieved content, false application log, poisoned memory, shared resource between two agents, emergency revocation), the four timings, which control actually stopped the chain and where, and a dated remediation log.

entries.name: Mode 13 — Returns Read
entries.essence: Produces the four returns in earned order — avoided loss; permission to deploy; speed once controls are shared infrastructure; externally visible trust as evidence.
entries.apply: Use for "what is this costing / what does it buy." Never call security a revenue line; state the sequence (control the risk, deploy, standardize, earn trust).

entries.name: The Live-Incident Fast Lane
entries.essence: When something is happening now, skip the router: Contain (revoke, disable, freeze, block, quarantine — pre-authorized cases fire without a person) → Preserve (capture infrastructure-layer evidence before restart) → Then investigate (enter Mode 4 with the evidence map).
entries.apply: Never run the autopsy while the credential is live; never accept "let it run so we can observe" without a blast-radius reading first.

entries.name: Mode Composition Rules
entries.essence: Compound requests route as ordered mode sums — e.g. "secure our new agent product" = 3+8+12 (scope, design, rehearse); "we got breached" = 4+6+9; "board deck" = 1+10 (never 10 alone); "vendor embedding agents" = 11+3+7; "annual strategy" = 1+9+13.
entries.apply: Decompose compound asks into their modes and run in the mandated order; hand inference cost/margin questions to the AI Economics seat.

entries.name: Refusing Correctly Is a Deliverable
entries.essence: Certain asks are refused and replaced with the real control — a stricter system prompt is replaced by charter + action-proxy rule + frozen test case; a policy-before-census by the census procedure; a posture score out of 10 by the six-gauge panel; a model swap by failure-family attribution; "approve now, scope later" by a time-boxed narrow grant; self-auditing by sampling against raw evidence; skipping the drill by the 90-minute minimum drill; penalizing a caught agent by the manufactured-desperation diagnostic.
entries.apply: When asked for guidance-shaped fixes to consequential problems, refuse, log the refusal, and deliver the runtime replacement.

entries.name: Web² (Web Squared)
entries.sectionName: The Foundational Frame — Growth Changed Its Object
entries.essence: AI compounds the web rather than replacing it; growth is engineered on a web the intelligence multiplies, not on a web the intelligence deletes.
entries.apply: Frame every discovery and distribution decision as compounding on the existing web rather than as a replacement platform.
entries.body:
AI compounds the web rather than replacing it; growth is engineered on a web the intelligence multiplies, not on a web the intelligence deletes.
- **Apply**: Frame every discovery and distribution decision as compounding on the existing web rather than as a replacement platform.

entries.name: Outside-In vs. Inside-Out (AI Is Inside-Out)
entries.sectionName: The Foundational Frame — Growth Changed Its Object
entries.essence: AI is inside-out — the operating model changes first, the business model next, distribution last. Growth is engineered from the operating core outward.
entries.apply: In Stage 0, place the firm on the sequence — has AI changed the operating model? the business model? distribution? — and start growth where the change already is.
entries.body:
AI is inside-out — the operating model changes first, the business model next, distribution last. Growth is engineered from the operating core outward.
- **Apply**: In Stage 0, place the firm on the sequence — has AI changed the operating model? the business model? distribution? — and start growth where the change already is.

entries.name: Retention Is the Ceiling
entries.sectionName: The Foundational Frame — Growth Changed Its Object
entries.essence: Retention is not a return visit but an outcome kept; it caps how large the firm can grow because acquisition leaks out through whatever the outcome fails to hold.
entries.apply: Treat outcome retention as the constraint on the whole growth model, not as a late-funnel metric.
entries.body:
Retention is not a return visit but an outcome kept; it caps how large the firm can grow because acquisition leaks out through whatever the outcome fails to hold.
- **Apply**: Treat outcome retention as the constraint on the whole growth model, not as a late-funnel metric.

entries.name: The Click Is Gone; the Loop Remains
entries.sectionName: The Foundational Frame — Growth Changed Its Object
entries.essence: The click — the atomic unit of the web era's growth — is being deleted at the discovery line; what compounds instead is the loop.
entries.apply: Whenever a plan is built on clicks, traffic, or funnels, replace it with a named loop and its referee.
entries.body:
The click — the atomic unit of the web era's growth — is being deleted at the discovery line; what compounds instead is the loop.

entries.name: The Property Line
entries.essence: Every firm sits on one of three positions — substance owner (pays the discovery tax), toll authority, or settlement rail; most firms are the first. Each asset gets a property-line decision before it is published or fed to a machine reader.
entries.apply: In Stage 0 place the firm on the line; in Stage 1 register every meaningful asset with its decision and reason.

entries.name: The Property-Line Decision (cite / license / fence / route around)
entries.essence: Every asset gets one of four decisions — cite, license, fence, or route around — deciding how (and whether) a machine reader may consume it.
entries.apply: Make and log the decision per asset before publishing or feeding it to any machine reader; record asset, decision, reason, machine readers affected, date, owner.
entries.body:

entries.name: The Discovery Line
entries.essence: The line where users find the firm is now mediated by machines (answer engines, assistants, agents) rather than by a human click; the firm sits on one side, the buyer on the other, with a dashed engine between.
entries.apply: Place every firm on the discovery line first — what share of finding is machine-mediated versus a human click — before advising anything.
entries.body:

entries.name: The Answer Loop

The drip becomes the gauge page, win-back becomes the drift check, and churn prediction becomes an outcome-rate forecast; the agent-account lifecycle is a contract where the gauges keep publishing.

entries.name: Pricing Is the Loop Selector

entries.name: The Ecosystem Loop (The App Store Without Screenshots)

List where agents look, in the format each registry/directory/agent-store reads; the integration is a callable endpoint, not a screenshot listing, and the marketplace-sourced cohort is tracked.

entries.name: Attribution Collapsed; Incrementality Survives

entries.body:
The path runs through a model, so multi-touch attribution collapsed; only incrementality survives, designed as a counterfactual per channel.

entries.name: Community Is the Citation the Machine Trusts

entries.body:
Community, when structured, attributed, and on the firm's property, becomes the citation the machine trusts rather than a rented social presence.

entries.name: The Metrics That Died

Pageviews, sessions, MAU, seats, CTR, content volume, and engagement assumed a human reader and a click; they are retired, logged with date and reason, before any loop is designed.

entries.name: The Six Instruments
entries.essence: Install citation share, agent share & agent conversion, time-to-magic, outcome retention, cost per accepted outcome, and NRR — each with source, cadence, and owner.

Install citation share, agent share & agent conversion, time-to-magic, outcome retention, cost per accepted outcome, and NRR — each with source, cadence, and owner.

entries.name: Citation Share
entries.essence: The share of relevant machine answers naming the firm, measured per engine that matters.
entries.apply: The answer loop's referee; instrument as engines × query classes × share with a cadence.
entries.body:
The share of relevant machine answers naming the firm, measured per engine that matters.

entries.name: Agent Share & Agent Conversion

entries.body:
The share of arrivals that are agents, and their completion rate on their own terms, counted as a separate cohort.

entries.name: Outcome Retention

entries.body:
The share of cohorts whose outcome kept arriving, replacing return-visit retention.

entries.name: The Counterfactual as Referee

Every experiment has a held-out counterfactual the experimenting loop cannot alter (holdout, geo split, DiD, synthetic control) and grades on an outcome metric, never a proxy.

entries.name: Every Loop Has a Referee It Cannot See

Each loop has a named builder and a named referee; a loop with one owner is a channel wearing a loop's name.

entries.name: Growth Goodhart

When a growth measure becomes a target, the loop games it (Goodhart 1975 / Strathern 1997); every gamed metric is catalogued as a case.

entries.name: The Retired-Metric Log

entries.body:
The firm's names, products, people, and claims resolve unambiguously across the surfaces a machine reads, with conflicts listed.

entries.name: Activation Is the First Outcome

entries.name: The FDE Definition (Four Removals)
entries.essence: An engineer embedded at the customer's constraint, building production machinery from the customer's real cases, with a wired-in duty to convert deployment learning into product. Remove the embedding and it's a vendor; remove the machinery and it's a consultant; remove the product duty and it's a body shop — and the one continuity that survives the title's inflation is accountability to the customer for the outcome.
entries.apply: Use as the test for whether a role, contract, or motion is genuinely FDE. Run the removals to diagnose what a degraded "FDE" has actually become.
entries.body:
An engineer embedded at the customer's constraint, building production machinery from the customer's real cases, with a wired-in duty to convert deployment learning into product. Remove the embedding and it's a vendor; remove the machinery and it's a consultant; remove the product duty and it's a body shop — and the one continuity that survives the title's inflation is accountability to the customer for the outcome.
- **Apply**: Use as the test for whether a role, contract, or motion is genuinely FDE. Run the removals to diagnose what a degraded "FDE" has actually become.

entries.name: The Three-Word Compression
entries.essence: Embed at the constraint. Build what compounds. Transfer the keys.
entries.apply: The one-line discipline applied to every engagement; use as the sanity check that a deployment plan does all three, not just the first.
entries.body:
Embed at the constraint. Build what compounds. Transfer the keys.
- **Apply**: The one-line discipline applied to every engagement; use as the sanity check that a deployment plan does all three, not just the first.

entries.name: The Three Seats
entries.essence: Every FDE question is answered from one of three seats — the firm running the motion, the enterprise receiving it, and the engineer building the career — and the same facts produce different advice per seat; never blend seats silently.
entries.apply: Declare the seat before advising. When advice feels contradictory, check whether two seats are being mixed.
entries.body:
Every FDE question is answered from one of three seats — the firm running the motion, the enterprise receiving it, and the engineer building the career — and the same facts produce different advice per seat; never blend seats silently.
- **Apply**: Declare the seat before advising. When advice feels contradictory, check whether two seats are being mixed.

entries.name: Stage 0 — Seat and Coordinate Check
entries.essence: Declare the seat (vendor / buyer / internal / individual), then place the enterprise coordinate — regulatory density, data gravity, process type (vertical vs. horizontal), and strategic weight — because the coordinate tunes every recommendation.
entries.apply: Run first on any deployment-shaped engagement. High regulation favors application-layer depth and clean title; high data gravity pulls machinery on-premise; high strategic weight pulls toward internal ownership.
entries.body:
Declare the seat (vendor / buyer / internal / individual), then place the enterprise coordinate — regulatory density, data gravity, process type (vertical vs. horizontal), and strategic weight — because the coordinate tunes every recommendation.
- **Apply**: Run first on any deployment-shaped engagement. High regulation favors application-layer depth and clean title; high data gravity pulls machinery on-premise; high strategic weight pulls toward internal ownership.

entries.name: Stage 1 — The Wedge Test
entries.essence: Every candidate problem is scored on four required gates — Volume, Specifiability, Verifiability, Pain — plus two filters, Reversibility and data proximity; ALL gates required.
entries.apply: Score candidate problems before selecting a pilot. The scorecard is the engagement's first artifact and the customer owns it from day one.
entries.body:
Every candidate problem is scored on four required gates — Volume, Specifiability, Verifiability, Pain — plus two filters, Reversibility and data proximity; ALL gates required.
- **Apply**: Score candidate problems before selecting a pilot. The scorecard is the engagement's first artifact and the customer owns it from day one.

entries.name: Stage 2 — The Embedding Plan
entries.essence: Archaeology of the process as practiced from the floor; everything learned files to a system of record on the customer's systems (written-first, non-negotiable); a golden set of 60–100 signed cases; and a threshold of time-to-magic ≤ 30 days to first verified production win.
entries.apply: Use to structure the first weeks on site. Sit with the people who do the work, not their managers; miss the 30-day window and the pilot enters purgatory.
entries.body:
Archaeology of the process as practiced from the floor; everything learned files to a system of record on the customer's systems (written-first, non-negotiable); a golden set of 60–100 signed cases; and a threshold of time-to-magic ≤ 30 days to first verified production win.
- **Apply**: Use to structure the first weeks on site. Sit with the people who do the work, not their managers; miss the 30-day window and the pilot enters purgatory.

entries.name: Stage 3 — The Field Build
entries.essence: A fixed build order under field conditions — suite frozen early (also the political instrument); harness from customer material; model behind a clean joint (demonstrated by swapping a second vendor's model); agent cadence; graduate in public.
entries.apply: Follow the order when building the production machinery. Iteration count is the compounding variable — rebuild by afternoon, repeat 3–4 days.
entries.body:
A fixed build order under field conditions — suite frozen early (also the political instrument); harness from customer material; model behind a clean joint (demonstrated by swapping a second vendor's model); agent cadence; graduate in public.
- **Apply**: Follow the order when building the production machinery. Iteration count is the compounding variable — rebuild by afternoon, repeat 3–4 days.

entries.name: Stage 4 — Cascade and Residue
entries.essence: Every expansion candidate goes through the same scorecard in the open; around unit three, split retail units from wholesale substrate and install the roster before the governance question arrives; and a residue review at every checkpoint asks what was built for the second time.
entries.apply: Use when expanding beyond the first wedge. File repeated patterns to the harvest hierarchy; keep the customer's substance the customer's, licensed openly.
entries.body:
Every expansion candidate goes through the same scorecard in the open; around unit three, split retail units from wholesale substrate and install the roster before the governance question arrives; and a residue review at every checkpoint asks what was built for the second time.
- **Apply**: Use when expanding beyond the first wedge. File repeated patterns to the harvest hierarchy; keep the customer's substance the customer's, licensed openly.

entries.name: Stage 5 — Title and Handover
entries.essence: Ask the five title questions before signature and verify them at milestones; the handover is an acceptance test where named customer operators run the machinery hands-off for a defined period, and the engagement closes on demonstrated operation, not the calendar.
entries.apply: Use to close an engagement cleanly. "A customer who could leave and does not is the only reference worth having."
entries.body:
Ask the five title questions before signature and verify them at milestones; the handover is an acceptance test where named customer operators run the machinery hands-off for a defined period, and the engagement closes on demonstrated operation, not the calendar.
- **Apply**: Use to close an engagement cleanly. "A customer who could leave and does not is the only reference worth having."

entries.name: The Wedge Gates (Four Gates, Two Filters)
entries.essence: Volume (recurs often enough that a unit earns its build within a quarter), Specifiability (correct outcomes can be written down), Verifiability (results checkable against real adjudicated cases), Pain (someone senior feels it weekly, by name) — plus filters Reversibility and data proximity.
entries.apply: The gate structure for scoring any wedge. A candidate failing any single gate is refused regardless of its other strengths.
entries.body:
Volume (recurs often enough that a unit earns its build within a quarter), Specifiability (correct outcomes can be written down), Verifiability (results checkable against real adjudicated cases), Pain (someone senior feels it weekly, by name) — plus filters Reversibility and data proximity.
- **Apply**: The gate structure for scoring any wedge. A candidate failing any single gate is refused regardless of its other strengths.

entries.name: The Three Refused Wedges (Hard Rules)
entries.essence: The moonshot is refused regardless of sponsor seniority (discovery consumes the trust window); the trivial wedge is refused regardless of ease (a win nobody feels recruits no second charter); the demo wedge is flagged (vendor convenience is not the customer's constraint).
entries.apply: Use as automatic refusals in wedge selection, even under pressure from a senior sponsor.
entries.body:
The moonshot is refused regardless of sponsor seniority (discovery consumes the trust window); the trivial wedge is refused regardless of ease (a win nobody feels recruits no second charter); the demo wedge is flagged (vendor convenience is not the customer's constraint).
- **Apply**: Use as automatic refusals in wedge selection, even under pressure from a senior sponsor.

entries.name: Process Archaeology
entries.essence: The process as practiced, recorded from the floor — exception rates, workarounds, the spreadsheet nobody mentioned — by sitting with the people who do the work, not their managers.
entries.apply: Run before committing to a build, and as the fix for the demo wedge (archaeology before commitment).
entries.body:
The process as practiced, recorded from the floor — exception rates, workarounds, the spreadsheet nobody mentioned — by sitting with the people who do the work, not their managers.
- **Apply**: Run before committing to a build, and as the fix for the demo wedge (archaeology before commitment).

entries.name: Agent Cadence
entries.essence: Arrive with the agent already built; invite the customer to say why it is wrong; transcribe objections into agent context; rebuild by afternoon; repeat over 3–4 days.
entries.apply: The daily rhythm of the field build. Ten turns in another team's one is a different regime.
entries.body:
Arrive with the agent already built; invite the customer to say why it is wrong; transcribe objections into agent context; rebuild by afternoon; repeat over 3–4 days.
- **Apply**: The daily rhythm of the field build. Ten turns in another team's one is a different regime.

entries.name: Iteration Compounding
entries.essence: Iteration count is the compounding variable of the field build — more turns per unit of time produces a qualitatively different result.
entries.apply: Optimize the build loop for turn count; treat slowness in iteration as the binding constraint.
entries.body:
Iteration count is the compounding variable of the field build — more turns per unit of time produces a qualitatively different result.
- **Apply**: Optimize the build loop for turn count; treat slowness in iteration as the binding constraint.

entries.name: Graduate in Public
entries.essence: Thresholds pre-agreed with the sponsor, gauges published weekly to a page the sponsor reads, promotion staged with a date and a signature.
entries.apply: Use to convert a working build into an accepted, signed graduation — never a private declaration of success.
entries.body:
Thresholds pre-agreed with the sponsor, gauges published weekly to a page the sponsor reads, promotion staged with a date and a signature.
- **Apply**: Use to convert a working build into an accepted, signed graduation — never a private declaration of success.

entries.name: Retail Units, Wholesale Substrate
entries.essence: Around unit three, split the customer-facing retail units from the shared wholesale substrate (shared record, identity/permissions, gauge tooling) and install the roster before the governance question arrives.
entries.apply: Use when cascading past the first deployment to avoid scattered, ungoverned units.
entries.body:
Around unit three, split the customer-facing retail units from the shared wholesale substrate (shared record, identity/permissions, gauge tooling) and install the roster before the governance question arrives.
- **Apply**: Use when cascading past the first deployment to avoid scattered, ungoverned units.

entries.name: The Residue Hierarchy (Harvest Hierarchy)
entries.essence: What was built for the second time is filed up a hierarchy — playbook (cuts weeks) → toolkit (cuts cost) → product (changes the business model) — with the pattern owned by the vendor and the customer's substance owned by the customer, licensed openly.
entries.apply: Run a residue review at every checkpoint; promote patterns on a cadence to protect the margin curve.
entries.body:
What was built for the second time is filed up a hierarchy — playbook (cuts weeks) → toolkit (cuts cost) → product (changes the business model) — with the pattern owned by the vendor and the customer's substance owned by the customer, licensed openly.
- **Apply**: Run a residue review at every checkpoint; promote patterns on a cadence to protect the margin curve.

entries.name: The Five Title Questions
entries.essence: Who owns the suite (portable to another model)? Where does the record live? Whose are the encoded standards? Does the unit survive a model swap? Who operates after handover?
entries.apply: Ask before signature and verify at milestones; the share of engagements meeting all five at handover is the title-cleanliness meter.
entries.body:
Who owns the suite (portable to another model)? Where does the record live? Whose are the encoded standards? Does the unit survive a model swap? Who operates after handover?
- **Apply**: Ask before signature and verify at milestones; the share of engagements meeting all five at handover is the title-cleanliness meter.

entries.name: The Handover Test
entries.essence: The handover is an acceptance test — named customer operators run the machinery hands-off for a defined period — and the engagement closes on demonstrated operation, not the calendar.
entries.apply: Write into the contract as a clause; also the absorption mechanism for bootstrapping an internal function with external FDEs.
entries.body:
The handover is an acceptance test — named customer operators run the machinery hands-off for a defined period — and the engagement closes on demonstrated operation, not the calendar.
- **Apply**: Write into the contract as a clause; also the absorption mechanism for bootstrapping an internal function with external FDEs.

entries.name: The Pattern License
entries.essence: The abstracted shape of the solution is retained by the vendor and licensed openly; the customer's substance stays the customer's.
entries.apply: State openly in the contract to reconcile productization with clean title.
entries.body:
The abstracted shape of the solution is retained by the vendor and licensed openly; the customer's substance stays the customer's.
- **Apply**: State openly in the contract to reconcile productization with clean title.

entries.name: Institutional Sovereignty
entries.essence: Ownership of the decision rights of the business — the buyer's overriding frame, audited against four worries: lock-in, subsidy, rule change, and cost.
entries.apply: Use in the Sovereignty Audit. Score the five title questions per engagement and place the client on the gradient per use case.
entries.body:
Ownership of the decision rights of the business — the buyer's overriding frame, audited against four worries: lock-in, subsidy, rule change, and cost.
- **Apply**: Use in the Sovereignty Audit. Score the five title questions per engagement and place the client on the gradient per use case.

entries.name: The Four Worries
entries.essence: Lock-in (can the process swap its model?), subsidy (does consumption revenue fund a vendor positioned to compete with you?), rule change (can a third party alter your machinery's behavior without consent?), and cost (are you paying frontier prices for craftsman work an owned task-specific model could do?).
entries.apply: The audit checklist for a buyer assessing vendor dependency.
entries.body:
Lock-in (can the process swap its model?), subsidy (does consumption revenue fund a vendor positioned to compete with you?), rule change (can a third party alter your machinery's behavior without consent?), and cost (are you paying frontier prices for craftsman work an owned task-specific model could do?).
- **Apply**: The audit checklist for a buyer assessing vendor dependency.

entries.name: The Decision Loop Is the Alpha
entries.essence: The decision loop — data seen, reasoning applied, action taken, outcome observed — is the firm's alpha and the training material for owned models.
entries.apply: Name and protect the decision loop as the deepest asset in any sovereignty audit; it is what an owned model would be trained on.
entries.body:
The decision loop — data seen, reasoning applied, action taken, outcome observed — is the firm's alpha and the training material for owned models.
- **Apply**: Name and protect the decision loop as the deepest asset in any sovereignty audit; it is what an owned model would be trained on.

entries.name: The Ownership Schedule
entries.essence: A table of every artifact class (suites, records, standards, prompts, checks, dashboards, connectors, playbooks) with its owner and a testable portability requirement, verified at milestones.
entries.apply: The first contract artifact; drafting one from memory is a career-stack exhibit for commercial literacy.
entries.body:
A table of every artifact class (suites, records, standards, prompts, checks, dashboards, connectors, playbooks) with its owner and a testable portability requirement, verified at milestones.
- **Apply**: The first contract artifact; drafting one from memory is a career-stack exhibit for commercial literacy.

entries.name: The Pricing Ladder
entries.essence: Pricing matched to proof — fixed-fee wedge → outcome terms once the frozen suite exists → subscription once residue is product; outcome pricing without a verification instrument is a dispute schedule.
entries.apply: Climb the ladder as proof accumulates; never sell outcomes before the verification suite exists.
entries.body:
Pricing matched to proof — fixed-fee wedge → outcome terms once the frozen suite exists → subscription once residue is product; outcome pricing without a verification instrument is a dispute schedule.
- **Apply**: Climb the ladder as proof accumulates; never sell outcomes before the verification suite exists.

entries.name: Attribution × Autonomy Grid
entries.essence: A pricing grid — seats where attribution is weak, usage where autonomy runs without attribution, outcomes where the system owns a verifiable result.
entries.apply: Select the pricing model by locating the engagement on the two axes of attribution and autonomy.
entries.body:
A pricing grid — seats where attribution is weak, usage where autonomy runs without attribution, outcomes where the system owns a verifiable result.
- **Apply**: Select the pricing model by locating the engagement on the two axes of attribution and autonomy.

entries.name: The Guarantee (The Guarantor Is the FDE)
entries.essence: Outcome pricing requires a guarantor, and the guarantor is the FDE.
entries.apply: Only offer outcome terms where an FDE stands behind the result; use as a structural rule in contract architecture.
entries.body:
Outcome pricing requires a guarantor, and the guarantor is the FDE.
- **Apply**: Only offer outcome terms where an FDE stands behind the result; use as a structural rule in contract architecture.

entries.name: The Repeated Game
entries.essence: The commercial relationship is a repeated game — good-faith value assessment because both sides want the next round.
entries.apply: Frame pricing and negotiation as ongoing rather than extractive; the philosophy behind clean title and fair terms.
entries.body:
The commercial relationship is a repeated game — good-faith value assessment because both sides want the next round.
- **Apply**: Frame pricing and negotiation as ongoing rather than extractive; the philosophy behind clean title and fair terms.

entries.name: Start After the Pattern
entries.essence: Begin the practice only after 2–3 founder-led deployments prove a repeatable wedge; hiring ahead of the pattern builds a body shop with a thesis.
entries.apply: Gate any field-team hiring on a proven wedge pattern; the fix for the premature practice.
entries.body:
Begin the practice only after 2–3 founder-led deployments prove a repeatable wedge; hiring ahead of the pattern builds a body shop with a thesis.
- **Apply**: Gate any field-team hiring on a proven wedge pattern; the fix for the premature practice.

entries.name: The Founding Pair
entries.essence: A principal-grade FDE plus a commercial counterpart, because the motion sells outcomes and change together.
entries.apply: Staff the zero-to-one motion as a pair, not a lone engineer.
entries.body:
A principal-grade FDE plus a commercial counterpart, because the motion sells outcomes and change together.
- **Apply**: Staff the zero-to-one motion as a pair, not a lone engineer.

entries.name: The OS in Order
entries.essence: Build the operating system — deployment record → harvest channel → meters — before headcount, because meters installed later measure a mythology.
entries.apply: Sequence the motion's infrastructure ahead of hiring.
entries.body:
Build the operating system — deployment record → harvest channel → meters — before headcount, because meters installed later measure a mythology.
- **Apply**: Sequence the motion's infrastructure ahead of hiring.

entries.name: The Pod
entries.essence: One pod per account — senior + 1–2 developing engineers + commercial counterpart — with a senior carrying at most two mid-sized engagements.
entries.apply: Use as the staffing unit and the ceiling on senior load.
entries.body:
One pod per account — senior + 1–2 developing engineers + commercial counterpart — with a senior carrying at most two mid-sized engagements.
- **Apply**: Use as the staffing unit and the ceiling on senior load.

entries.name: The Harvest Ratio
entries.essence: The protected ratio of output promoted to reusable residue, defended from quarter one.
entries.apply: Track and protect from the start; a proxy for whether the motion is compounding.
entries.body:
The protected ratio of output promoted to reusable residue, defended from quarter one.
- **Apply**: Track and protect from the start; a proxy for whether the motion is compounding.

entries.name: The Refusal Log
entries.essence: A kept record — from inquiry one — of engagements declined, with reason, reconsider trigger, and date.
entries.apply: Maintain alongside the meters; it shapes the pipeline and is the discipline the meters can't show alone.
entries.body:
A kept record — from inquiry one — of engagements declined, with reason, reconsider trigger, and date.
- **Apply**: Maintain alongside the meters; it shapes the pipeline and is the discipline the meters can't show alone.

entries.name: The Four-Part Test
entries.essence: Strategic workflows, regulatory density, data gravity, repeat volume across BUs — meet one, buy the motion with clean title; meet all four, build in-house (or pay vendor margins to build someone else's residue).
entries.apply: Use as the build-vs-buy decision for an internal AI function.
entries.body:
Strategic workflows, regulatory density, data gravity, repeat volume across BUs — meet one, buy the motion with clean title; meet all four, build in-house (or pay vendor margins to build someone else's residue).
- **Apply**: Use as the build-vs-buy decision for an internal AI function.

entries.name: The Four Inversions
entries.essence: For an internal motion: funded by the served P&L in attention returned; sponsorship replaces sales but wedge discipline survives (internal purgatory is real); residue accumulates as the firm's own harness; title answers itself.
entries.apply: Redesign the FDE motion's economics and discipline when the customer is internal.
entries.body:
For an internal motion: funded by the served P&L in attention returned; sponsorship replaces sales but wedge discipline survives (internal purgatory is real); residue accumulates as the firm's own harness; title answers itself.
- **Apply**: Redesign the FDE motion's economics and discipline when the customer is internal.

entries.name: The Central Practice
entries.essence: A central practice deploying into units — never scattered heroes — with the center owning playbook, substrate, roster, and rotation.
entries.apply: Use as the org shape for an internal FDE function.
entries.body:
A central practice deploying into units — never scattered heroes — with the center owning playbook, substrate, roster, and rotation.
- **Apply**: Use as the org shape for an internal FDE function.

entries.name: The Diagonal Hire
entries.essence: Grow the diagonal (domain expert who learns the machinery — the adjuster who learns the build) rather than losing the premium bidding war for outside talent.
entries.apply: Use as the internal talent strategy; second chairs finished in the field.
entries.body:
Grow the diagonal (domain expert who learns the machinery — the adjuster who learns the build) rather than losing the premium bidding war for outside talent.
- **Apply**: Use as the internal talent strategy; second chairs finished in the field.

entries.name: Five Species, One Motion
entries.essence: Five species of FDE motion — model layer, data platform, application layer, services, internal — each with its own answer to what the motion funds, where the residue lands, title posture, and governing meter.
entries.apply: Place the firm among the species, accept its business model whole, and let the coordinate select the customers. The classic failure is one motion with five species' pricing and no species' economics.
entries.body:
Five species of FDE motion — model layer, data platform, application layer, services, internal — each with its own answer to what the motion funds, where the residue lands, title posture, and governing meter.
- **Apply**: Place the firm among the species, accept its business model whole, and let the coordinate select the customers. The classic failure is one motion with five species' pricing and no species' economics.

entries.name: Title Posture as Strategy
entries.essence: Title posture varies by species — application layer wants tight title as the moat; services want clean title as the engine.
entries.apply: Set contract title posture deliberately from the chosen species, not by default.
entries.body:
Title posture varies by species — application layer wants tight title as the moat; services want clean title as the engine.
- **Apply**: Set contract title posture deliberately from the chosen species, not by default.

entries.name: The Six Meters
entries.essence: Read together and on trend — time-to-magic, expansion rate, outcome conversion, productization rate, margin trajectory, title cleanliness — beside the refusal log, rejecting vanity substitutes (deployments launched, hours billed, agents deployed).
entries.apply: Use as the motion's instrument panel; the productization rate predicts the margin curve and title cleanliness is the meter durable firms publish and captors resist.
entries.body:
Read together and on trend — time-to-magic, expansion rate, outcome conversion, productization rate, margin trajectory, title cleanliness — beside the refusal log, rejecting vanity substitutes (deployments launched, hours billed, agents deployed).
- **Apply**: Use as the motion's instrument panel; the productization rate predicts the margin curve and title cleanliness is the meter durable firms publish and captors resist.

entries.name: Margin Trajectory as Unharvested Residue
entries.essence: The gap to the originator's software-margin benchmark is the firm's unharvested residue.
entries.apply: Read the margin gap not as fate but as a measure of residue left on the floor.
entries.body:
The gap to the originator's software-margin benchmark is the firm's unharvested residue.
- **Apply**: Read the margin gap not as fate but as a measure of residue left on the floor.

entries.name: The Vintages / The Vintage Question
entries.essence: The same title covers five jobs — platform stability, integration, enablement, solutions, and the outcome-owning arc — and the question is which vintage a seat is and whether it builds the whole stack or one layer.
entries.apply: Vintage-parse any FDE seat before signing; the fix for the dumping-ground title.
entries.body:
The same title covers five jobs — platform stability, integration, enablement, solutions, and the outcome-owning arc — and the question is which vintage a seat is and whether it builds the whole stack or one layer.
- **Apply**: Vintage-parse any FDE seat before signing; the fix for the dumping-ground title.

entries.name: The Skill Stack
entries.essence: Four layers, each proved by an artifact — engineering depth, domain fluency, field craft, commercial literacy — audited in order.
entries.apply: Audit your own stack layer by layer; build the missing proving artifact (e.g., a solo-built harness, a practitioner process map, a drafted ownership schedule).
entries.body:
Four layers, each proved by an artifact — engineering depth, domain fluency, field craft, commercial literacy — audited in order.
- **Apply**: Audit your own stack layer by layer; build the missing proving artifact (e.g., a solo-built harness, a practitioner process map, a drafted ownership schedule).

entries.name: The Rung Ladder
entries.essence: Second chair (a signed suite) → owned wedge (a public graduation) → owned engagement (a handover that held) → cascade lead (a program that survived rotation) → principal (the harvest); promotion on artifacts, not tenure.
entries.apply: Place yourself on the ladder and name the next exhibit to hold.
entries.body:
Second chair (a signed suite) → owned wedge (a public graduation) → owned engagement (a handover that held) → cascade lead (a program that survived rotation) → principal (the harvest); promotion on artifacts, not tenure.
- **Apply**: Place yourself on the ladder and name the next exhibit to hold.

entries.name: The Three Stalls
entries.essence: The career stalls are the brilliant builder who never takes the contract conversation and the account hero who never files residue (the third being the general failure to advance on artifacts).
entries.apply: Name the stall if visible in a career diagnosis and prescribe the missing move.
entries.body:
The career stalls are the brilliant builder who never takes the contract conversation and the account hero who never files residue (the third being the general failure to advance on artifacts).
- **Apply**: Name the stall if visible in a career diagnosis and prescribe the missing move.

entries.name: The Four Arcs
entries.essence: Jump triggers out of the seat — product (after ~2 years of filed harvest), the practice (when you'd rather build the system that builds), founding (when the same wedge repeats across 3+ deployments — the deployment record is the era's best startup thesis), and the enterprise (when a customer offers the mandate).
entries.apply: Use to time a career move. "The seat's compensation is the salary; the career's compensation is the residue."
entries.body:
Jump triggers out of the seat — product (after ~2 years of filed harvest), the practice (when you'd rather build the system that builds), founding (when the same wedge repeats across 3+ deployments — the deployment record is the era's best startup thesis), and the enterprise (when a customer offers the mandate).
- **Apply**: Use to time a career move. "The seat's compensation is the salary; the career's compensation is the residue."

entries.name: The Portfolio Rule
entries.essence: One deployment narrated at full grain beats a repository of prototypes, with de-substanced artifacts attached.
entries.apply: Build the FDE portfolio around a single deep narrated engagement, not a pile of demos.
entries.body:
One deployment narrated at full grain beats a repository of prototypes, with de-substanced artifacts attached.
- **Apply**: Build the FDE portfolio around a single deep narrated engagement, not a pile of demos.

entries.name: The Last Mile
entries.essence: Models deploy in minutes but value deploys through the work itself — the FDE covers the entire last mile: the motion, the contract, the team, the career, and both sides of the table.
entries.apply: Frame the FDE's value as the last mile between a capable model and a captured outcome.
entries.body:
Models deploy in minutes but value deploys through the work itself — the FDE covers the entire last mile: the motion, the contract, the team, the career, and both sides of the table.
- **Apply**: Frame the FDE's value as the last mile between a capable model and a captured outcome.

entries.name: Deck vs. Machine
entries.essence: The distinction between selling a presentation and building working production machinery on the customer's floor.
entries.apply: Use to test whether an engagement is producing a machine or a demo.
entries.body:
The distinction between selling a presentation and building working production machinery on the customer's floor.
- **Apply**: Use to test whether an engagement is producing a machine or a demo.

entries.name: Product Development in the Field
entries.essence: Product is developed in the field from the customer's real cases, with a wired-in duty to convert deployment learning back into product.
entries.apply: Treat every deployment as a source of product, not just a service delivery.
entries.body:
Product is developed in the field from the customer's real cases, with a wired-in duty to convert deployment learning back into product.
- **Apply**: Treat every deployment as a source of product, not just a service delivery.

entries.name: The Job Is to Automate the Job
entries.essence: The FDE's mandate is to automate the job — the second loyalty wired into the cadence, not to become the best contractor in the ticket queue.
entries.apply: Use as the guard against staff-aug drift.
entries.body:
The FDE's mandate is to automate the job — the second loyalty wired into the cadence, not to become the best contractor in the ticket queue.
- **Apply**: Use as the guard against staff-aug drift.

entries.name: The Capture Question
entries.essence: Whether the motion is building voluntary dependence (a customer who could leave and stays) or coercive lock-in that backfires into a lost account.
entries.apply: Ask whenever dependency is being designed; clear title by contract is the answer.
entries.body:
Whether the motion is building voluntary dependence (a customer who could leave and stays) or coercive lock-in that backfires into a lost account.
- **Apply**: Ask whenever dependency is being designed; clear title by contract is the answer.

entries.name: Voluntary Dependence
entries.essence: The durable outcome — a customer who could leave and does not — as opposed to maximized dependency that loses the account to an exit-cost analysis.
entries.apply: Aim contracts and handovers at voluntary dependence; it is the only reference worth having.
entries.body:
The durable outcome — a customer who could leave and does not — as opposed to maximized dependency that loses the account to an exit-cost analysis.
- **Apply**: Aim contracts and handovers at voluntary dependence; it is the only reference worth having.

entries.name: The Motion Maturity Ladder
entries.essence: Five grades of motion maturity — F0 Heroics, F1 Wedge discipline, F2 The record exists, F3 Proof converts terms, F4 The residue compounds, F5 The position — graded honestly, with the productization rate as the tell (most motions claiming F4 are F1 with good branding).
entries.apply: Grade a motion's maturity; below one residue promotion per quarter, the residue is evaporating and the F-claim is inflated.
entries.body:
Five grades of motion maturity — F0 Heroics, F1 Wedge discipline, F2 The record exists, F3 Proof converts terms, F4 The residue compounds, F5 The position — graded honestly, with the productization rate as the tell (most motions claiming F4 are F1 with good branding).
- **Apply**: Grade a motion's maturity; below one residue promotion per quarter, the residue is evaporating and the F-claim is inflated.
entries.note: Source correction: F0 through F5 contains six levels, although the description says “five grades”. The promotion cadence is a source heuristic, not an independently calibrated threshold.

entries.name: The Object of the Sale
entries.essence: The object of the sale changed from software shipped to outcomes installed; name what is actually being sold — assistance (humans still do the work), usage (the system works without clean attribution), or a verifiable outcome — because everything downstream (proof, price, paper) follows the object.
entries.apply: Stage 0 of every deal. Flag the mismatch immediately when a client sells outcomes on a seat price or proves outcomes with a demo.
entries.body:
The object of the sale changed from software shipped to outcomes installed; name what is actually being sold — assistance (humans still do the work), usage (the system works without clean attribution), or a verifiable outcome — because everything downstream (proof, price, paper) follows the object.
- **Apply**: Stage 0 of every deal. Flag the mismatch immediately when a client sells outcomes on a seat price or proves outcomes with a demo.

entries.name: Risk Asymmetry
entries.essence: The buyer's downside always exceeds the seller's, so the sale is a risk-reduction machine wearing a revenue target.
entries.apply: Design for the buyer's risk before your pitch — the permanent physics behind every mode.
entries.body:
The buyer's downside always exceeds the seller's, so the sale is a risk-reduction machine wearing a revenue target.
- **Apply**: Design for the buyer's risk before your pitch — the permanent physics behind every mode.

entries.name: The Diagonal Competitor
entries.essence: The seller who has both commercial and field/engineering literacy — the diagonal — commands a premium on both sides.
entries.apply: Use in org design and career development; AEs build proof literacy, FDEs build commercial literacy.
entries.body:
The seller who has both commercial and field/engineering literacy — the diagonal — commands a premium on both sides.
- **Apply**: Use in org design and career development; AEs build proof literacy, FDEs build commercial literacy.

entries.name: Assertion vs. Instrument
entries.essence: The era demands an instrument where sellers used to rely on assertion; the root cause of every deal failure is assertion where an instrument was required, and the fix is always to install the instrument.
entries.apply: The universal diagnostic lens. Any diagnosis ending in "push harder at quarter-end" is rejected.
entries.body:
The era demands an instrument where sellers used to rely on assertion; the root cause of every deal failure is assertion where an instrument was required, and the fix is always to install the instrument.
- **Apply**: The universal diagnostic lens. Any diagnosis ending in "push harder at quarter-end" is rejected.

entries.name: Stage 0 — Object Check
entries.essence: Name what is actually being sold — assistance, usage, or verifiable outcome — since proof, price, and paper all follow the object.
entries.apply: First move in any deal. Flag object/price and object/proof mismatches at once (e.g., outcomes sold on a seat price, outcomes proved with a demo).
entries.body:
Name what is actually being sold — assistance, usage, or verifiable outcome — since proof, price, and paper all follow the object.
- **Apply**: First move in any deal. Flag object/price and object/proof mismatches at once (e.g., outcomes sold on a seat price, outcomes proved with a demo).

entries.name: Stage 1 — The Account Gates
entries.essence: Five gates, ALL required (workflow density, data reachability, champion material, economic visibility, survivable procurement), plus two filters (reference gravity, expansion room); trophies and easy closes are declined in writing into the refusal log.
entries.apply: Qualify and select accounts. Treat the account list as a portfolio of future proof; map sibling workflows before the first contract.
entries.body:
Five gates, ALL required (workflow density, data reachability, champion material, economic visibility, survivable procurement), plus two filters (reference gravity, expansion room); trophies and easy closes are declined in writing into the refusal log.
- **Apply**: Qualify and select accounts. Treat the account list as a portfolio of future proof; map sibling workflows before the first contract.

entries.name: Stage 2 — The People
entries.essence: Pass the behavioral champion test, build the champion's career case both ways, arm them with weapons that survive retelling, and hold the multi-thread stage gate — no proposal ships until economic buyer, a user leader, and procurement have each been met.
entries.apply: Stakeholder work on every deal. Single-threaded deals die with a resignation letter.
entries.body:
Pass the behavioral champion test, build the champion's career case both ways, arm them with weapons that survive retelling, and hold the multi-thread stage gate — no proposal ships until economic buyer, a user leader, and procurement have each been met.
- **Apply**: Stakeholder work on every deal. Single-threaded deals die with a resignation letter.

entries.name: Stage 3 — The Case and the Proof
entries.essence: Build the case skeleton (baseline → mechanism → commitment → payback in the buyer's own numbers) as one maturing document with the proof instrument, then sell the paid, time-boxed production wedge rather than climbing the demo ladder.
entries.apply: When proof is needed. Pre-agree verification; ≤ 30 days to first verified win; hand deployment machinery to the FDE skill at this stage.
entries.body:
Build the case skeleton (baseline → mechanism → commitment → payback in the buyer's own numbers) as one maturing document with the proof instrument, then sell the paid, time-boxed production wedge rather than climbing the demo ladder.
- **Apply**: When proof is needed. Pre-agree verification; ≤ 30 days to first verified win; hand deployment machinery to the FDE skill at this stage.

entries.name: Stage 4 — The Gauntlet and the Paper
entries.essence: Map procurement/security/legal with the champion in week one and run their clock concurrent with the proof's; deploy the artillery early and paper the deal (ownership schedule, pricing ladder, expansion frame, handover clause) via a mutual action plan.
entries.apply: From meeting one. Volunteered early = accelerant; extracted late = concessions. Closing is the plan's last checkbox.
entries.body:
Map procurement/security/legal with the champion in week one and run their clock concurrent with the proof's; deploy the artillery early and paper the deal (ownership schedule, pricing ladder, expansion frame, handover clause) via a mutual action plan.
- **Apply**: From meeting one. Volunteered early = accelerant; extracted late = concessions. Closing is the plan's last checkbox.

entries.name: Stage 5 — Price and Compounding
entries.essence: Price by the attribution × autonomy grid, hold discount discipline (defend on the gauge page, trade structure not price), and show the compounding — unit prices fall on the substrate while account value rises.
entries.apply: Commercial terms and renewals. Never seat-price agentic work; grade the account by NRR.
entries.body:
Price by the attribution × autonomy grid, hold discount discipline (defend on the gauge page, trade structure not price), and show the compounding — unit prices fall on the substrate while account value rises.
- **Apply**: Commercial terms and renewals. Never seat-price agentic work; grade the account by NRR.

entries.name: Account Scorecard
entries.essence: Candidates in rows, the five gates and two filters in columns, the buyer-market's real numbers in the cells; output is a ranked list, chosen accounts with a 90-day proof thesis, declined accounts with written reasons, and an expansion-room map.
entries.apply: For ICP, territory, and qualification questions. Never rank on logo, deal size, or inbound enthusiasm — gates only.
entries.body:
Candidates in rows, the five gates and two filters in columns, the buyer-market's real numbers in the cells; output is a ranked list, chosen accounts with a 90-day proof thesis, declined accounts with written reasons, and an expansion-room map.
- **Apply**: For ICP, territory, and qualification questions. Never rank on logo, deal size, or inbound enthusiasm — gates only.

entries.name: Deal Design
entries.essence: Run Stages 0–5 into a dated arc (scorecard → champion test → case + schedule → gauntlet → paid wedge → suite frozen → first win → graduation → outcome conversion → expansion signature), marking the trust clock and procurement clock each week.
entries.apply: To plan strategy for a named opportunity. Include the gauge-page design and its distribution list (the CFO reads it). Routinely spawns Proof Design and Gauntlet Prep.
entries.body:
Run Stages 0–5 into a dated arc (scorecard → champion test → case + schedule → gauntlet → paid wedge → suite frozen → first win → graduation → outcome conversion → expansion signature), marking the trust clock and procurement clock each week.
- **Apply**: To plan strategy for a named opportunity. Include the gauge-page design and its distribution list (the CFO reads it). Routinely spawns Proof Design and Gauntlet Prep.

entries.name: Champion Builder
entries.essence: Stakeholder map in the five languages, champion identified by behavioral test, career case drafted both ways, arsenal assembled, and a multi-thread plan with named seconds per thread.
entries.apply: For stakeholder mapping and internal politics. Flag single-thread as a stage-gate violation, not a style note.
entries.body:
Stakeholder map in the five languages, champion identified by behavioral test, career case drafted both ways, arsenal assembled, and a multi-thread plan with named seconds per thread.
